Ejaz Ahmed allegedly stabbed to death Muhammad Shafiq in Choor Chak village as the deceased had illicit relations with a woman relative of the accused.
ASI, Fazle Azam, murdered the sister of General Fazle Haq along with her husband and daughter, wanting to claim their property.
A bullet-riddled body was found from the ground of APWA school in Korangi. He was identified as the brother-in-law of an Muttahida Qaumi Movement worker in Landhi.

An attack on party activists of the Jamiat Ulema Islam left Nek Mohammad Abro dead and his father and two other women injured. No other detail was given as the report itself was extracted from a statement by JUI condemning the incident.
Bodies of two brothers who had previously gone missing were found in Humrung Beebak area. According to the family, they had fallen victim to terrorism.

Militants attacked a checkpost in the Frontier Region of Bannu and kidnapped 12 security personnel. The checkpost, which was manned jointly by the military and paramilitary soldiers, was attacked by around 120 militants, in which 4 people were injured. It was said that the militants who attacked the checkpost were Local Taliban.
Vice President of Press Clun Vehari, Mr. Javaid Iqbal Qureshi, was injured when unknown assailants on a motorcycle opened fire on him and injured him.
A young man, Asif of Phalia, severely beat up and killed his sister with an axe on suspicion of having an illicit relationship.
An Afghan student of local madressa, Roohullah, was injured in a bomb explosion in Haji camp. The bomb disposal collected material from the site to determine the nature of explosive material.

Tribesmen belonging to Zakakhel, Shinwari and Malagori tribes thretened the governmet to restore electricity supply to their areas, else they would destroy the electricity installations. WAPDA (Water and Power Development Authority) had previously tried to install electricity meters in tribal area ( to bill the people for their electricity use) but their effort was resisted by the tribes. Thus the government had cut the elctricity supply.

Suspected militants planted to explosive devices at Government Primary School Khalil for Girla, located in the densely populated  area of tehsil Bazaar. The device destroyed four classrooms and a boundary wall.
An employee of the Karachi Television Corporation was found dead in Pak Colony. He had reportedly been kidnapped a day before.
A monetary dispute took lives of three people including two brothers in Peshawar.
Residents of Akhtar Colony blocked the main road by burning tyres and placing hurdles. After a few hours the protesters dispersed peacefully on the assurance of police officials.
Three persons were injured in an armed clash between two groups of Lohar community over a karo-kari dispute in village Ghulam Hussain Leghari.

Following the shooting of a man by the police, relatives and friends of the deceased blocked the main road, burnt tyres and chanted slogans against the police. The police claimed that he was a 'criminal' was trying to flee after firing at the house of Dr. Tahir Iqbal.
17 people were injured when Pahur and Shar tribes clashed at a Jirga.
secuirty forces recovered 6 hand grenades from a water cooler in Miramshah Bazaar. The bomb disposal squad defused the hand grenades. They detained 18 shopkeepers and took them for interrogation.
A boy was wounded when a rocket landed near him in Haleemzai tehsil. Witnesses siad the rocket was accidently fired by a man moving about with a group of gunmen.
A PML former Councillor Saeed Bhatti was gunned down by unknown assailants in Baghbanpura Chowk on Sunday
during the security forces operation in areas around Pir Baba in Buner, six terrorists' hideouts were destroyed.
A mini bus was torched by miscreants.

A Haqiqi worker was kidnapped and killed, later his body was dumped near the 'Deaf and Dumb School' in the Old Exhibition Area. The victim was the body guard of the brother of a Haqiqi leader, Chacha Mansoor.
The body of a Daska trader, Chaudhry Faiz Ahmad, was found in Girjakh area after he was missing for five days. According to the police, his body had marks of torture on it.
An elderly man was shot dead allegedly by his neighbour on suspicion that he had helped the killers sister elope with a man.

While protesting against the murder of worker by the factory owner, violent mob pelted stones on some of the foundries and shops in Faisalabad-Samundari Road on Tuesday. They also damaged the vehicles and burnt tyres.

Two people were killed in a shootout between rival groups in Model town. Two groups of alleged land grabbers, lead by Shahida Bhinder, a woman councillor of Gulberg Town, and Asad Riaz, a former police constable, had a dispute over the possession of a flat. A few of Asad's accomplices came in and tried to occupy the flat, which was resisted by Shahida's accomplices. They exchanged arguments followed by a scuffle, and in the ensuing crossfire, 2 people were killed and one injured.
5 persons were gunned down by armed persons over Karo-kari on Sunday

activists of the Jeay Sindh Qaumi Mahaz (B) and its student wing took out processions and held demonstrations across the province against the influx of IDPs into Sindh. In Larkana, activists of JSQM-B and Jeay Sindh Students Federation took out a procession and distributed pamphlets calling for a complete strike in the district on May 23rd. the pamphlets warned traders of 'consequences' if they opened their shops.
Two people were clubbed and injured by rivals over a property dispute in Wazirabad village.

A young man was allegedly gunned down and four others, including an aged woman, were injured when his rival group opened indiscriminate fire on him while he was standing outside his house in Gowalmandi area. According to sources, a dispute had developed between the two parties before the recent general election.

Clashes between Mangal and Bangash tribes continued, claiming 5 more lives and leaving 10 more people injured. The clashes started over 2 weeks ago with a dispute over distribution of irrigation water.

In a peaceful protest by PRTC workers in Lahore on Wednesday, police lathicharged and used teargas to disperse the crowd. As the original article was not reported, details are being taken from this article.
Gul Hassan Tunio was injured when his rival unleashed dogs on him. The dispute between the two parties was on a land dispute which was pending in the court. The victim accused Wadero Shafi Mohammad.
One person was killed and 2 others were wounded in Indian shelling along LoC in Neelum Valley on Thursday
Some unidentified motorcyclists fired on Bhurguri road in which Yar Khan Pathan was seriously injured.
11 militants were killed when helicopter gunships and artillary were used to attack militant positions in Kurram
sub-inspector Tariq Khan and his friend Chaman Gul were kidnapped from the Kohat road by suspected militants.
A levy sepoy, identified as Muhammad Yub, was killed near Hangu Railway crossing. The deceased was wearing a uniform and had his service rifle woth him.
Anwer Khairi gunned down his sister Reshman on the suspicion that she was having illicit relations with a man.

A suicide bomber rammed his explosive-laden car into a convoy of the FC which contained American soldiers and journalists as well. The convoy was on its way to inaugurate a school in Kad. The dead included 3 US soldiers, 4 school girls and 1 paramilitary soldiers. 2 US army trainers and 2 journalists were among the injured victims, most of whom were school girls. The Taliban claimed responsibility for the attack and alleged that the US personnel on board were members of US security company Blackwater Worldwide, now known as Xe.
Mr Hatim Lakharawal, son of a business tycoon was kidnapped and later killed by unknown men in SITE Area on Saturday.

supporters of 7 student groups staged a demonstration on NED University campus, against the Vice Chancellor Dr. Jamil Ahmed Khan, and were baton charged by Rangers. 5 of them were injured. The BSO, IJT, PSF, Pakhtoon Students Federation, Punjabi Engineering Students Association and the Jeay Sindh Students Federation all took part in this demonstration organized by the 'Students Action Committee'.

Fayyaz Haideri, an activist of Tehrik-i-Jafria Pakistan, was tortured to death in police custody after he was arrested from his shop in Badami Bagh. The autopsy results confirmed that the victim was tortured to death. The police, however, claimed that the victim had hanged himself in police custody.

Dr Sarfaraz, President of IJT was killed in a clash between IJT and Pakistan Progressive Students Alliance activists. Sophisticated weapons were used in the clash. No arrests could be made. The situation remains tense on campus.

Militants attacked a security checkpost in Kurram. In retaliation, security forces fired back and attacked their hideouts with heavy artillery fire. 5 militants were killed and 2 hideouts completely destroyed. Prior to the attack on the checkpost, the militants had kidnapped 15 tribesmen belonging to the Para Chamkani tribe
3 missiles fired by a US Drone at a house late at night killed 4 suspected militants.
3 militants were killed and one security perosonnel was injured in Wanai area of Matta tehsil.

Four people, including two Afghan refugees, were killed while thirteen others were injured when a bomb exploded in a spare parts shop near Charsadda bus stand in Peshawar. The explosion set fire to a nearby cylinder shop, and also damaged various other shops in the tripple storey building. A truck and five buses parked in the vicinity were also damaged. The Chief Minister did not rule out the possibility of sabotage.
a sepoy, Mahboob was killed when militants attacked the troops. Security forces said they killed 10 militants in a counter attack.
Two friends sleeping at the back of a mosque opposite Grain market were clubbed and injured by unidentified people.

According to sources, dozens of Taliban militants attacked a security post in the Kitkot area of Mamund tehsil in Bajaur, killing one soldier and injuring another. Upon retaliation by the security forces, three militants were killed while the rest were driven back into Afghanistan.
An activist of the Sunni Tehrik was shot dead standing outside his party office in New Karachi, when two unidentified assailants on a motorbike opened fire on him, killing him on the spot.

Protests over the renaming of NWFP took place in Haripur where demonstrators ransacked and set on fire the office of PML-N MNA Sardar Mushtaq Khan and pelted the house of ANP's provincial minister Qazi Asad with stones. A complete strike was observed in the city.
Two groups of activists of the Lashkar-i-Islam opened fire on each other after a heated exchange of words. A local commander Chatral Khan was killed in the firing.

According to Bugti Tribe sources fierce clashes between security forces and Bugti tribesmen took place in Ghundoi and Surlop area of Dera Bugti. They also claimed to have killed eight security officials. However, the incidents are not confirmed by official sources.
A bomb was planted within the premises of a school in UP society on Monday which was defused by Bomb Disposal Squad on Monday.
Mohammad Zahid was gunned down outside his house. The Pak Colony police said that they were looking for Qadeer who was nominated in the FIR.
Pattoki police baton charged and injured around half a dozen traders who were protesting against police excesses.
A man killed his seveteen year old wife with an axe on suspicion of bad character, and later surrendered himself to the police.

A clash occurred between activists of MQM and PPP. The PPP claimed that the car carrying its MNA Naheed Khan came under attack. The windscreen of the vehicle was smashed. This was refuted by TPO, Malir, Altaf Hussain Leghari, saying that he visited the area and everythig was normal. This incident took place during the by-elections for 3 NA seats and 1 PA seat.
Mohammad Saddique was killed and his brothers, Mohammad Hanif and Saifullah, were injured when 3 men attacked them with axes due to an old land dispute.

Masked men on motorbikes resorted to indiscriminate firing in New Karachi and North Nazimabad, killing 6 people and injuring another 11. The motive behind the firing was not known. The Army was called out as it became increasingly difficult for the police to control the situation. ; Follow-up: A follow-up report claims that 7 people were killed.
A man was shot at and injured allegedly by rivalson the premises of deepalpur kutchery on Friday.
Two Afghan refugees were killed and two others were injured when a bomb of high intensity went off in a truck outside the tentage village of Manda near Shabqadar, 40 kms from Peshawar.
A bomb exploded near a mosque however no casualties or damage was reported.
Some unidentified assailants shot at and critically injured Haji Fidaur Rahman, The victim was the grandson of Maulana Abdullah Dehalvi, founder of the Maderessa Jamia Ashraful Loom.

The Railways police received information about a bomb planted in a train. They  then called the Bomb Disposal Squad who examined the area and found 3 stick like bombs in the area and defused them. According to a police officer, they were a new type of powerful local bomb.

Two tribes of North and South Waziristan Agencies clashed over a petty dispute. Both tribes used heavy weaponry, resulting in the death of Ismail- son of Khan- and Ghafoor- son of Waziri. There were also 2 people injured. The political administration rushed to the area to negotiate a ceasefire.

Ten people, three women and four children were killed when military planes bombed a house in the Feroze khel area of Orakzai. Two other empty houses were also razed to the ground. Officials claimed that except the women and children all other dead were militants while independent sources said that all that were killed were civilians.
A man was killed In Mominabad.

A group of people in a Suzuki High-Roof vehicle attacked the police in Korangi area which led to an exchange of fire in which 1 youth was killed while another was injured. The police also managed to seize the vehicle which had Sindh Government registration plate.
The Station Master of Larkana Railway Station, Mr Islamuddin Shaikh, was seriously injured when armed men opened fire at him.
On-going wave of violence continued in Karachi. The bullet-riddled body of a young man was found in the Lyari river.

Four armed men shot dead three people, including a retired police inspector, when they were sitting outside a shop. According to details, the assailants wanted to stop former sub-inspector Chaudhary Talib Olakh from pursuing a murder case. But the deceased did not oblige to them.
Qamar Javaid Gujjar, former Kot Nakka union council nazim and former Pindi Bhattian bar president, was shot and injured by his rivals.

two terrorist hideouts were destroyed in Meragai.this was one of the incidents for which the army has claimed that 23 terrorists were killed and 5 were captured during operationsin Swat and Dir on 1-jul-09 and 2-jul-09.

Asad Nawaz, an old student of Islamia College, and his four accomplices opened fire in Islamia College to harass their rivals. The accused harassed a student Raheel to leave the Anjuman Talba Islam and then fired shot into the air.
Pir Allama Shah Nazar, who was a local leader of the JUI-F and a cleric, was shot dead while he was sitting inside a mosque. The two assailants were claimed to be Darya Khan and his son Ikram.

2 back to back suicide bombings at the administrative compound in Ghalanai killed at least 40 people and injured more than 60. The first militant blew himself up at the main gate while the second detonated himself inside the compound while a meeting of government officials, allied tribal elders and members of anti-Taliban malitia was taking place. The TTP claimed responsibility for the attack. Among those killed were 12 government officials, 2 television journalists, a tribal elder and several security guards.
The third drone strike of the day targeted a pick up truck, killing all 5 people on board.

Sargodha prison officials allegedly tortured an under-trial prisoner due to which he 'lost his senses'. It was reported that the man was allegedly implicated in a Hudood case on charges of attemtping suicide, due to political rivalry, and he was reportedly tortured at the behest of his political opponents.

A blast took place at Lahore hotel on GT road killing one customer and injuring 24 others. The incident took place six kilometers away from the site where the annual congregation of Lashkar I Taiba was taking place.
A woman was wounded when she was hit by a stray bullet in Aziz Bhatti.

following the clashes at GCT and DMC the supporters of one student group stoned Karachi University buses near NIPA Chowrangi and tried to set ablaze public busus near Islamia College, Hasan Square and Tibbat Centre.; Faisla bin Anjum, an office bearer of JI, Old City Area, Abdul Karim Vayani who was injured in an attack on JI office on the 24th died on the 25th.
Two government employees were killed in Kawsar area of Khar. Details not available.
The body of an old man, murdered by unidentified killer(s) was found floating on the river.
Security forces killed 3 militants identified as Hazrat Hussain, Akbar Hussain and Attaullah.

An ASI of police was shot dead by five armed men near Sultankot. According to police, Ghulam Nabi Soomro and four of his accomplices, armed with guns and pistols, murdered the ASI of Sultankot Safdar Ali Mangi.  The motive behind the murder was not stated in the report.
A police checkpoint on the main Khwazakhela road near Gunj Alam was destroyed. The explosion was heard in far-off areas and caused panic amond the people.
The body of Imran Tanoli, 30 was found. He was believed to be kidnapped and hit on the head with a blunt object. Police have not been able to determine the motive behind the murder.

Unidentified men opened fire on Maulana Bashir Ahmed Khaki, President SSP, Shorkot, while he was offering prayers at a mosque. The Maulana's bodyguards retaliated, forcing the assailants to flee. The Maulana escaped unhurt.
A villager was shot at and wounded in attack by armed assailants in Jafar Khan Laghari Village on Friday
Scattered incidents of firing were reported from the area near Safoora Goth. However, no casualty was reported.
A man was killed when unidentified gunmen sprayed a passenger coach with bullets.
25 shops were damaged in an explosion in the Darya Khan markeet in Mingora bazaar.

Seven member of Qambrani and Mafrani clans were killed in an armed clash in Saleh Issani village in Shikarpur. The clash took place after people from Qmbrani clan attacked Amir Bux Mafrani the previous night.
Moin Khan, a government official who worked for the Provincial Communications and Works department was shot dead in front of his house by unknown assailants on a motorbike.
Six people in a barber shop were injured when someone hurled a hand grenade in it.
A body of a young man was found in a desolate place.
A man murdered his wife for her alleged affair with a youth in Jhandu Sahi-Bambaanwala village in Daska. He slit her throat while she was asleep.
Councillor Akhtar Husain Bajwa and three followers were injured in an armed clash with a rival councillor and his three supporters. The dispute was over the contruction of a road.

the Kohat prison authorities called in additional force to control the situation when 'Taliban' inmates resorted to a protest against the arrest of their collegue from the jail mosque. They broke taps and pipes and accused the police of desecrating the mosque. the matter was later settled between the jail administration and the Taliban.

Taliban ambushed security foces when the latter were returning to base camp after a raid and a serach operation. The ambush left 1 soldier dead and 4 others injured. Security forces exchanged fire after which the Taliban fled.

More than 100 flood affected IDPs demonstrated in front of Jinnah Bagh against the government for not providing proper food and medical facilities at IDP camps. They burnt tyres and PPP flags and also force shopkeepers to close their businesses.

Fierce fighting erupted between volunteers of a local lashkar and militants when militants ambushed two vehicles of a peace committee. Two vehicles carrying volunteers of the peace committee from Lakaro to Kareer for a search operation were attacked by militants when they reached the area. The armed volunteers retaliated, and the security forces sent reinforcements to aid the volunteers against the militants.
A van, No. PE-1802, was set on fire
A man was injured in Pak Colony.

Following the strike call given by MQM steering committee, armed youths took to the streets and resorted to violence. Armed exchange between the police and protesters took place at the mentioned locations.
An elderly man, Muhammad Hussain was slaughtered by unknown persons while he was asleep in his house.
Two people were injured in incidents of shooting.

Three persons were killed and five others were injured in a clash that took place between supporters of the PPP and ANP at a polling station in Peshawer.  The shooting between parties lasted for three hours because some supporters of the ANP were using fake ID cards. Eyewitnesses claimed that both groups of supporters called their respective party leaders who rushed to the spot and a shoot out ensued.
Armed motorcyclists opened fire at 2 Nato oil tankers, forcing the drivers and other people on board to flee. They then set both tankers on fire.
A CD shop was blown up in Iranabad area of Mardan.

The labour union of the KESC along with residents of Akhtar Colony and neighbouring areas, protesting against the management, turned violent as they burned tyres, blocked traffic and pelted moving vehicles with stones. Police fired tear gas shells and used batons to disperse the crowd.
Troops backed by security forces continued to target militant hideouts in Kattkalla, Elum and Karakar areas.

12 paramilitary soldiers were killed when insurgents besiged a base camp of the Bajaur Scouts housed in a school building. However, contrary to official reports, militants claimed that 80 paramilitary officials had been killed.
Umer Daraz and Nawaz were killed when their rivals opened fire at them over irrigation water dispute. One Akhtar also sustained bullet injuries.
Miscreants entered a post office and through inflammable material inside, setting it on fire. No further details given.
A young man's body was found in Kokani Mohalla in Baldia Town.
A person was killed when two groups of the Narejo tribe clashed with each other over an old dispute.
A 'settler' Muhammad Iqbal and his son along with two other were injured in grenade attacks on their house by unidentified party.
An unidentified bullet-riddled body was found from Buffer Zone.
A remote controlled bomb exploded when a vehicle carrying personnel of Bhombor Rifles was passing.

The Muttahida Qaumi Movement and the Jeay Sindh Quami Mahaz jointly held a demonstration against the water shortages and alleged injustice against the Sindh. However, as they reached near Zainab Market in their attempt to reach the Governor's House, the police resorted to using batons and teargas to disperse the protesters. The protesters became violent and smashed window panes of dozens of vehicles. The shops closed down abruptly and the police arrested 40 people. 3 policemen and more than two dozen protesters were injured.

Eleven members of a family were killed and 17 others were injured when about 20 armed men of rival Chandio Tribes stormed the Karmi Chandio village in Gharo. The the deceased belonged to the family of Lateef Chandio, who had allegedly given information about Paro Chandio, a dacoit, to the police two years ago.

As part of the violence on the second day of a two-day strike called by the Mohajir Qaumi Movement (MQM), four bodies were found stuffed in gunny bags from a car at Millet Gardens in Malir. Their hands and feet were tied and they had bullet holes in their heads.
Six militants were killed in a clash with security personnel in Qambarkhel area. This was a part of the operation 'Here I come again' by the military to clear the area of militants.
Four unidentified assailants shot dead Wajid Hussain while he was asleep in his outhouse. The motive behind the incident could not be ascertained.

Data Ganj Bakhsh Town Nazim, Khwaja Hassaan ordered that the pornographic material that was being sold outside the Railway Station be burnt and ordered a crackdown on all internet clubs that show pornographic material.
a dispute over a piece of land resulted in an armed clash between two parties. One man was injured.

Shafiur Rehman, a student of the MAO College was injured when 2 warring factions of the Muslim Students Federation exchanged fire over \holding\" the college hostel. The hostel is presently occupied by the Abid Chaudhry group of MSF, and were attacked by the Arshad Amin Chaudhry group."

3 men of the Chandio clan barged into the house of Fata Muhammad Maree and opened fire, killing Ghulam Khan Maree and injuring his wife. The reason for the attack is said to be an old feud between the Chandio and Maree clans.
Militants fired four rockets on an FC checkpost in Jawni area which exploded in an open area.
In Gojar Garhi in Mardan, there was an exchange of indiscriminate fire, resulting in seven people being seriously injured.
Firing by Indian troops from across the LoC left one man injured.
Militant fired a rocket on the police van in Doaba area killing two policemen and injuring three others.
2 students were killed in a clash between students of Jeay Sindh Students and SPSF in Mehran University of Engineering and Technology in Jamshoro on Friday.

A girl who allegedly survived an 'honour killing' attempt was found unconscious near Saggian Bridge in Ravi and was admitted to the hospital with severe neck injuries.  According to sources her uncle had always admonished her for having loose morals and she had left with him last she was seen.
A man, Mumtaz Khan, was shot dead by Ghulam hussain, Akbar and Haji Muhammad. The accused wanted to grab a piece of land possessed by the deceased.

People of Chowk Munda Town took out a procession to protest against the Chairman of Union Council and his accomplices who had allegedly raided a girl's school and misbehaved with the teachers after drinking liquor. The mob pelted a police party with stones after which the police resorted to baton charge. Some agitators attempted to set some buildings on fire after which the police opened fire. It was alleged that 7 people were killed and 11 injured as a result. However, the police claimed that 3 people were killed and 20 were injured.
Mr. Anwar was mysertiously found dead in the field.
The unidentified body of a woman was found in Shahdara town on Saturday
3 men, who were suspected of having developed 'illicit relations' with a girl were attacked and injured by 6 armed men, believed to be the relatives of the girl.
a strike was observed in Balochistan against the killing of the three Baloch leaders. A bomb exploded in Wadh area of Khuzdar district.
Three persons were injured in a bomb explosion in Shikarpur. Two suspects were later taken into custody.

Protesters, mainly comprising of Sunni Tehreek activists, tried to stage a protest against the death sentence awarded to Salman Taseer's murderer, Mumtaz Qadri. Police had blocked M.A.Jinnah Road near Numaish Chowrangi to avoid disturbance as was ordered by city officials, but the protesters managed to gather at the Chowrangi. Police had to resort to baton-charge and tear-gas shelling. Finally a water cannon was used to disperse the crowd.
One person was killed and 30 others, including a sub-inspector, were injured in a clash between to sectarian groups. Police used teargas to disperse the rioters.
2 armed persons stabbed their rival to death.
Five people were injured when a blast took place near a CD shop in Asif centre. A banned organisation had previously warned shopkeepers of Asif centre to stop the CD-video business.
a local cleric and his son were gunned down on 19-jul-09. their bodies were found on 20-jul-09.
A powerful explosion occurred near the house of PML Q candidate Sardar Hassani in Chagai.
A local made explosive device went off at the Government college in Mansehra destroying its wall.
Angry protesters, entered the town Hall builiding and smashed windows of the cars parked inside and besieged the building for two hours.Police secured the area.
Two sisters were shot dead by ten armed men, all allegedly belonging to the Chandio caste, when they burst into the house of Qurban Chandio and opened fire.

Three people were killed and six others suffered injuries when unidentified armed men opened indiscriminate fire on a passenger van near Kaghazai village, carrying passengers belonging to the Bangash tribe. In protest over the killings, angry Bangash tribesmen took 40 people hostage when they were passing through the Ustarsai and Sherkot areas.

JSM leader-Abdul Wahid Aresar was arrested during a raid by the Police on his house in Umerkot on Monday. During a press statement, he alleged that the police had tortured him and he was shifted to Umerkot hospital.

Two people were killed and eight others were injured when a roadside bomb  hit a Froebels School van on the main Pejagi Road, while a second bomb exploded a few metres from there, suspected to have targeted police. According to officials, the second bomb could not explode completely due to poor quality.
A police constable was shot dead by unidentified gunmen. The reason behind the killing is not known.
A FC checkpost was destroyed in the Bagh Ali area after being hit by six rockets. No casualty was reported.
An armed clash between two groups over cattle grazing occurred. 19 people were injured in an attack in which rifles, axes, iron rod and stones were used.
An unidentified man was shot dead in Nazimabad.
3 dead bodies were found in Khaisur village while a fourth one was found in Alikhel village. Locals said that the four men had been killed after being accused of spying for the US
Two members of a family were killed and two others were injured when a hand-grenade exploded in Sheja Town, Kangarh.
Armed men, allegedly belonging to the Kalhoro tribe, opened fire at Raja Khan Mangnejo, a notable tribesman from another tribe when he was sitting at a shop.

Speakers at a demonstration against prolonged power outages threatened to set ablaze the Chakdara grid station, houses of PESCO authorities and their vehicles if the problem was not resolved within a week. The protest was led by local political leaders.

In the aftermath of the assassination of a pro-Government tribesman who had announced that he would raise an anti-Taliban lashkar, TTP spokesman Hafiz Saeed warned those wishing to raise lashkars against the Taliban would face serious consequences.
12 people died and 13 were injured when \some explosive material\" went off in a residential colony. No other details were given."
Two brothers, Ali Ahmad and Imdad Ali, were killed by 7 armed men in Okara.

Three people were killed in an armed clash between two groups in Shikarpur district. The dead were identified as Noor Hassan Kambrani and Mehboob Kambrani while name of third person could not be ascertained.
4 men on two motorbikes offered a lift to Saeed Badshah, who was a 40-year-old man with a disabled leg. They took him to a deserted place and shot him dead.
Two landmines were defused by security forces.
An unidentified boy was found murdered in an open field in Feroze Park in the Shahdara area. He had several injuries to the head and other parts of the body.
A person was found dead in Bhatti Gate on Saturday
Abdul Qadir Rind was shot dead by unknown attackers near Shahwani Chowk in Sariab locality. The assailants riding a motorcyle escaped after the killing.
A US Drone fired 6 missiles at 2 pick-up trucks that were allegedly carrying arms and ammunition to Afghanistan. The attack killed at least 21 militants and injured another 4.
Two teenagers were injured when mortar shells fired by the Indian troops from across the LoC hit them.
a man and his wife were gunned down by unknown men who barged into their house in Khar area of Bajaur Agency. The accused managed to esape and authorities have ordered an inquiry into the incident.
The watchman of a vocational institute, Zahoor Ahmad, was found dead when a sweeper visited. He had been strangled with his hands and legs tied.
At a polling station in Spal Colony, a scuffle between two rival candidates led to their arrest.
Four shops were set ablaze.
A tribesman was killed in a blast in the Dwazai area of the Pindyali tehsil.

Air strikes by the military on Taliban hideouts in Dara Adamkhel destroyed the camps of two militant commanders, Qaiser and Zareen, and killed 2 militants. The attack was in retaliation to the militant attack on the Zor Kalay checkpost earlier.

The Indian Security Forces continued firing on Zafarwal, Charwa, Bajwat, Chaprar, Harpal, Sucheetgarh, Bajragarhi and Shakargarh sectors. As a result, the firing killed 2 baffaloes and badly damaged some houses as well as distrupted the sowing of paddy crop. The Chenab Rangers returned fire forcing the Indian armymen to flee to their bunkers.
Arshad of Baghyana village had allegedly developed illicit relations with a girl from Naniyanwala Khu. The relatives of the girl burnt him dead.
Three members of a family, Ahsaan, Shah Jehan and Zulfiqar were killed when armed men opened fire at them while they were at their outhouse.
One person was killed and another was injured in shooting in Shah Faisal Colony.
an explosive device damaged a bridge linking Miramshah with Bannu.

Protests against massive loadshedding of electricity in Punjab continued on the third consecutive day. In Bahawalnagar, traders took out  rallies in various parts of the city. They set tyres ablaze at one such rally at Kalma Chowk.
A union council Nazim of Landhi Town, Imran Ahmed, was shot dead by two men on a motorbike while he was sitting at a shop with his friends. The victim was associated with the MQM.
4 soldiers were wounded when an army convoy was struck by a remote controlled explosive device near Chashma bridge.
4 vehicles were burnt and property was damaged by unidentified people
Three people were shot dead by Bashir Ahmed and his fourteen accomplices over a land dispute. Bashir Ahmed opened fire at a  panchayat which was called in to resolve the land dispute.

A clash between the Sindh Peoples Student Federation (working committee) and Jeay Sindh Students Federation in polytechnic college caused injury to working committee organiser Riaz Abro. The clash occurred when the student groups exchanged harsh words during a paper of third year civil engineering.
Four unknown assailants attacked the house of Sha Wali and killed him. While fleeing they a;lso shot and injured to passers-by.
Three traders were injured when octroi staff, who were trying to collect a higher amount than the schedule, scuffled with the resistong traders. An inquiry was launched.
Azam Khan Mahsood, a leader of the Pakistan Muslim League labour wing was shot dead on his way from his newphews valima, when unidentified motorcyclists opened fire on him and fled.
The strife-hit areas of Karachi witnessed renewed violence, as dozens of arsonists stormed a factory in Sohrab Goth and torched at least 80 motorcycles parked outside.
An unidentified man was killed and another injured when unknown men opened fire at them.
Gulfam, 60, was shot at in Landhi. This incident occurred during the strike by MMA against the killings of its workers during the by-elections.
A police constable was killed when unidentified men intercepted him and opened fire while he was on his way back to the Saeedabad police station. They sped away with the victim's machine gun.
A Hindu landlord was killed by eight armed men of the Khaskheli clan over a dispute of agricultural land in Mirpurkhas.
Two men on a motorbike intercepted a bus and forced the driver, the conducter and the passengers off at gunpoint. They proceeded to set the vehicle on fire .

Militants fired five rockets, which landed in different areas of Hangu, but caused no casualties, police said. Officials said that three unexploded rockets were found in fields in the Togh Sarai area and two live rockets near Sarozai Piala area. District Police Officer Ghulam Muhammad said members of the bomb disposal squad defused the unexploded rockets.
Abdul Aziz was injured. No further details were given.

Activists of the ANP opened fire on JSQM activists following a dispute the night before. The ANP had hoisted their flags in an area that was considered a JSQM stronghold and the latter proceeded to remove them. The two groups were supposed to meet and resolve the issue the next day but instead the two groups clashed. However, the man killed did not belong to either party. A man working at a drycleaner shop and a pedestrian were also wounded.
Activists of the Sipah-i-Sahaba protested against the killing of SSP workers in Islamabad. They blocked K.K.H Road for several hours and damaged three shops.

A close relative of Mangal Bagh, the head of the Lashkar-i-Islam, died in the custody of security forces. Security forces insisted that Ismail, the deceased, died due to a heart attack but unofficial sources claimed that he was killed during interrogation.
Violence continued in Hyderabad and Latifabad for a second consecutive day when a truck was set on fire in Unit no. 12, Latifabad.

unidentified men shot dead a man, his wife and their two children. Relatives of the family said they had no enmity with anyone. Motives behind the killings are not ascertain. Bakot police have registered a case.

Two unidentified assailants shot at and injured the complainant of a sectarian murder case, Tanveer Naqvi, as he was heading home. He abandoned his bike and tried to flee. Tanveer is the complainant of the murder of his brother, Nisar Naqvi, who was shot dead in 1998.
Firing was reported from Rashid Minhas road where 3 shops near Fayyaz Plaza were also set on fire.

Mada Khel tribesmen clashed with Tochi scouts after negotiations between the political administration and the Mada Khel tribe broke down. The negotiations were concerning the land dispute between the Mada Khel Wazir and Khaddar Khel Wazir tribes that has resulted in a bloody conflict for the last 2 months.
a girl was shot dead by her brother for having run away with a man. He surrendered himself to the police after killing her.
a man was killed and 4 members of his familly were injured when a bomb exploded in their house in Awanabad area.
A bomb weighing about 500 grams was defused from the busy Shafi Market in cantonment area of Peshawar.
It was reported that the some armed men opened fire at the house of Federal Minister Ghulam Dastgir Khan and fled.
An amputated body was found from Bhogiwala, stuffed in a gunny sack.
A person was found dead near Boat Basin on Sunday. Police said that there were torture marks on his head

Two militants were killed and seven others were injured when security forces pounded the hideouts of Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan in the Akhorwal area of Darra Adamkhel using helicopter gunships. Officials claimed that two camps of Taliban commanders were also completely destroyed in the air strikes.
17 people were injured in firing in these areas. No further details were given.
A US drone fired two missiles at a vehicle, killing 4 people and injuring 1.
A man was killed in District west in in firing by some unknown persons.
Saeeda was stabbed to death by her husband, Abdul Hameed, as he suspected her of infidelity.

Militants attacked various checkposts in the Miramshah tehsil which led to clashes that lasted for about 2 hours. Both sides used rockets and missiles. 10 houses were damaged, a woman was killed and another woman and 3 children were injured.
A man, Bashir, strangled his niece on suspicion of illicit relations.
A vehicle of Sui Gas company was completely destroyed by protesters.
Violence broke out in different localities of the city in Quiadabad when people took to the streets and set fire to tyres, disrupting whatever traffic movement there was.

Bomb disposal squads of the police and the army found two rockets in Hangu that were believed to have been planted there to attack an army fort in Thall. They were still trying to difuse them till the filing of the report.

Five people were killed and 11 were wounded in the fresh incidents of violence in Kurram region as the two warring tribes - Toori and Bangash - continue to fight. Tribal elders have visited various areas to stop the fighting in the region.

As part of the on-going violence by the MQM in Karachi, youths took to the streets, lit bonfires and set, at least, 12 buses, minibuses, trucks and private vehicles on fire in areas of Nazimabad, Korangi, Garden, Nabi Naksh, Orangi, Azizabad, Pakistan Quarters, Arambagh, Liaquatabad and Gulbahar. Youths also exchange fire with the law enforcement agencies in the troubled region.
2 rival groups-led by Mian Shafiq and Waris- exchanged fire, injuring a passer-by (Abdul Hamid). The police reached the area and arrested 12 people including the Naib Nazim Mohammad Nasir.

An armed clash took place between the All Pakistan Muttahida Students Organization and the Pakhtoon Students Federation. In the aftermath of the clash, activists from one of the organizations blocked University Road and it took a baton-charge by the police to disperse them. An hour after a clash the body Sajid Abass, a student of the Gulistan-i-Jauhar Degree College was found. Police claim he was a victim of indiscriminate firing during the clash.

A strike was observed in several areas in order to protest against the police for registering false cases against the Rahu family. The protesters burnt tyres and the police baton-charged the protesters, injuring 1.

A clash occurred during a tribal jirga called to settle a land dispute between two groups of Laghari tribesmen. Guns, axes and clubs were used, thus 20 people were injured . The tribal chief of Laghari tribesmen, ex-MPA Johi, Sardar Akbar Khan Laghari represented one group and District President PPP, Rais Raffique Ahmad Jamali and Provincial Leader of the Pakistan Millat Party, Dr. Manzoor Ahmed Laghari, represented the other side.

many incidents of violence were seen followed by a city-wide shutdown, after the Jeay Sindh Qaumi Mahaz called for a strike to protest the influx of IDPs. the Garden police said that a woman was burned to death when a mob set a minibus of route P-1 on fire. they arrested 6 people for the incident.
During the strike called by religious parties against the US-led attack on Afghanistan, an Edhi ambulance was atacked by protesters.
Two trucks carrying supplies to Nato forces in Afghanistan were attacked by armed men. The assailants opened fire from nearby mountains, injuring 3 people including the driver.

Hundreds of people demonstrated against frequent robberies and pelted the police with stones when the latter tried to disperse them by resorting to baton charge. 5 pole protesters only dispersed after senior officials assured them that action would be taken against policemen showing negligence.
the body of an unidentified man was found in Rohi drain near Balhar Village, Nishtar Colony.

Students of the Government Degree College, Chichawatni took out a procession to protest against the high-handedness of a conductor and driver of a passenger bus against a student. They pelted buses with stones and 1 student was injured. The owners of the vehivles also retaliated adn threw stones at the students. 6 students were booked by the police for taking out an illegal procession.
Mohammad Nazir Mohmand, a renowned poet of Mohmand region, was found killed. The victim had been kidnapped from Peshawar by unknown men a couple of days ago.
Nawaz and Khizer Hayat had an agricultural land dispute. Nawaz and his accomplices opened fire on Khizer while he was watering his fields and killed him.
An 11 year old boy was injured and a tubewell was partially damaged when an explosive device went off in a village in Tor Chappar area of Dara Adamkhel.
In a clash between JSSF and SST, 5 JSSF students were injured. ; Follow-up: It was reported that the dispute was over the setting up of a board in the name of G.M.Syed and Fazil Rahu.

Some residents of Orangi Town No. 8 1/2 took to the streets and started protesting against the KWSB and the KESC. The raised slogans against the shortage of water and the power break downs. The police intervened and started to baton charge and throw teargas shells at the protesters to make them disperse. The protesters retaliated by pelting the protesters with stones and and setting fire to tyres.
A landmine blast left one woman dead and another injured.

A US drone strike killed three militants, when two missiles were fired at a vehicle as it drove through a village near Mubarak Shah Town in North Waziristan. Securtiy officials claimed that there were reports that a fourth militants had been killed but they were not yet confirmed.
A man was found hanged in a park in Shafiqabad area on Saturday

A massive car bomb exploded near a gathering that was held to commemorate the first death anniversary of Maulana Azam Tariq. People were leaving the venue when according to an eye witness a car rammed into the crowd and exploded, killing at least 39 and injuring at least 70. Nearby property was also damaged.

ARD activists gathered at the Concourse hall, however, the police pushed them towards the parking area to make them leave the airport. However, they started chanting slogans against the military regime. Lahore PPP (Women Wing) President Sajida Mir hit a sub-inspector with her sandal when he grabbed Qasim Zia (Punjab PPP President). There were no female police officers and male officials man-handled the female activists.
A rocket was fired at the home of federal minister Zubaida in Mand area.

Hundreds of prisoners had taken control of the Central Jail Mach in protest against body and barracks searches. The prisoners had set ablaze a training centre and some rooms inside the jail. Personnel of the Frontier Corps, Anti-Terrorist Force and police were called in to control the situation. They fired tear gas shells inside the jail to disperse the prisoners and fired blank shots in the air. The siege was ended when they prisoners' demands were met, and they released the 30 people they had held hostage for over 13 hours in protest.
An employee of the Police Foundation was shot dead by unknown assailants.
A villager was injured in Nagdar village in Neelum valley as the indian forces continued firing from across the LoC.

Abdul Rashid had suspicions that his younger brother had developed illicit relations with his wife and pretended to go out of the city. When he returned late at night, he allegedly found them in a compromising position and killed his wife with a  pillow, while his brother escaped. He later courted arrest and confessed to his crime.
An armyman was killed and two others were injured in the Kotkai village mosque during prayers when gunmen opened fire on him and his relatives.
A powerful bomb blast rocked Taftan, a border town on the Pakistan-Iran border when it exploded near a small law enforcement agency, damaging its wall.
following the killing of the baloch nationalist leaders violence erupted in Balochistan. a group of protesters damaged a date processing plant and a Nadra office.

5 activists of the Sunni Tehreek were arrested after they fired in the air to force shop keepers to shut their businesses on Tariq Road. Similar incidents of firing took place in other parts of Karachi as well. One person was injured in the violence and he was taken from New karachi to Abbasi Shaheed Hospital.
Defence Minister Ahmed Mukhtar's escort car GD-825 was hit by stones thrown at his mototrcade. This was in reaction to the Suprem Court's decision.
Fighter planes targeted suspected militant hideouts near the Pak-Afghan border, killing 4 and injuring 5 militants.
A minibus of route N-5 was intercepted and set on fire. The interior of the bus was severely damaged.
Suspected militants gunned down a member of a peace body in Bara, Khyber when they ambushed him on the Matani Shaikan Road in Peshawar.

Rehmatullah Hashmi, a student of Bahauddin Zakariya University Multan, was severely beaten up by some persons who used 'iron fists' and batons. The Vice-Chancellor was assured by two leaders of the IJT that legal action would be taken against the culprits.
An MQM worker was shot by unknown men near Gulberg Chowrangi.He later died in the hospital.
2 girls were murdered by unknown men in Sahiwal on Monday.
an explosion took place at Aabpara Hockey ground . But there was no loss of life or property.
Unidentified gunmen kidnapped 12 chidren from a playground in Arkot area of Matta tehsil. Th police refused to take action on grounds of \secuity risk\"."

Tenants attacked a local Military Dairy Farm (MDF) office, resulting in the injury of 2 MDF employees and 2 tenants. The riot started when MDF tried to dispossess thousands of tenants in 14 villages (some of those tenants have been on that land for 87 years). The tenants resisted the action and sent their representatives to the district courts but 12 of them were arrested. This enraged the tenants and they attacked a local MDF office. The SSP, City AC, some magistrates and police and some Elite force tried to intervene but had to retreat as the villagers stood their ground. A police contingent finally did manage to enter the village and arrest 5 people.
Two policemen identified as Ahmed Ali Channa and Rajab Ali Junejo were gunned down by unknown assailants on Wednesday when they attacked a picket of Behram police station
Shopkeepers clashed with the police while resisting an anti-encroachment drive. Several shopkeepers were injured in the baton charge. They later blocked the highway in protest.
The decomposed body of a 25-year old youth was found from a heap of refuse on Bund Road. Police apprehended that he might have been murdered.
Security forces in Lee Sam and Khar pounded militant hideouts in the area with artillery. Officials claimed that several hideouts were detroyed in the shelling.
a worker of the Muttahida Qaumi Movement, Ajmal Moeen, was shot dead in an attack in Shah Faisal Colony No.3 by 2 unidentified men on a motorcycle.
One person was killed and 4 were injured due to Indian shelling along LoC in Athmuqam sector on Tuesday

Relatives of prisoners protested against the police after the latter had injured 10 prisoners and killed 1 in the district jail. The prisoners had resisted a search operation in jail and the police had responded by firing and lobbing tear gas shells at them. The police dispersed the protesting relatives of the victims by charging at them with batons. The protesters later, armed with clubs, forced shopkeepers to observe a shutter down strike.

It was reported that a gang of criminals and bandits had been threatening villagers and extorting money from them. It is claimed that the gang had sealed Khairpur-Borari, Borari-Piaro and Kakar-Borari roads and had demanded Rs 500,000 a month from each village in the area. The gang is also accused of having visited primary schools in the area and asking teachers to make monthly payments to them for attending school. Such activities had paralysed life in the area and had resulted in the closure of two dozen schools. Mohammad Ramzan Bughio alleged that the police were not taking action as the local leaders of the ruling party were supporting the bandits. District President of JUI-F, Hafiz Mohammad Amin Jamali claimed, while speaking at a demonstration, that three villagers and a police constable had been killed by robbers earlier that month.
Bodies of eight bearded men were found from a deserted place near China Chowk on the Attock-Haji Shah Road. The police could not ascertain the reason behind the killings.
Unidentified assailants shot dead Zaheer Malik and injured his father and brother, while they were at home. The motive behind the incident was unknown.

Three policemen sustained injuries when suspected militants attacked a checkpost in the Milli khel area of Peshawar. They attacked from all directions, catching the policemen offguard. However, the police retaliated and forced them to retreat.
Militants fored rockets on a security checkpost in Sibi. No casualities occurred.
Two unidentified miscreants fired shots at the residence of a retired professor, damaging his car. The reason behind the firing was to scare the family.

Advocate Ghulam Nabi of the Peshawer High Court was allegedly picked up by personnel of an intelligence agency in three vehicles near the NWFP assembly, and released after a severe over night thrashing. He was associated with Jamaat-i-Islami and a critic of the army and intelligence agencies. The legal community observed a strike in protest to the event.

Five workers of the Taraqqi Pasand Party (TPP) were injured in a clash with the employees of a private jail when TPP workers went there to demand the release of all prisoners. The prisoners being kept in the jail were forced to work upaid for long hours in a day.

the supporters of two candidates for the seat of general coucillors attacked one another with clubs at the polling station in Nangal Ambia High School No 2, Mohallah Eidgah. Candidate Dilawar's brother injured Abdul Aziz.
There was a landmine blast

Two people were killed and two others injured when a fierce armed clash took place between Bhittani tribe and Marwat hamlets. The Bittani tribe had attacked the Marwat hamlets, who then retaliated in kind.

Muhammad Rafiq, a construction worker who was originally from southern Punjab, was targeted and killed by gunmen. It is reported that a majority of the victims of targeted killings following the assassination of Syed Raza Haider belonged to the labour class.

During a long march (started after Wapda disconnected power supply to people who did not pay their outstanding dues), the police and protesters clashed. At least 2 were killed and 15 (including 10 policemen) were injured

Militants set off a bomb damaging a girls's school in a village near Peshawer. Teachers and students of the school had received threatening letters, asking them to wear a veil or suffer the consequences.
an explosive device planted at a garbage dumping site in Safdar Town Gulbahar No.4 went off. A sanitary worker sustained injuries
A woman was killed by her husband on the pretext of karo-kari.

3 persons, including a constable and a municipal councillorCh Bashir Ahmad, were injured in an attempt to get encroachments removed from Defence Road. They asked the owners of a factory to remove their encroachments. The owners and workers of the factory responded by attacking them.
Two security pesonnel were wounded in an explosion in Ghathundhai

Mir Muhammad Khan, uncle of the Chief Minister Akram Khan Durrani, was shot dead when he was returning in his vehicle from Do Manza village from Surani village. Mr. Durrani died on the spot while his guard and driver received bullet injuries.
Unidentified youths tried to hijack a bus and stabbed a passenger to death when the latter put up resistence. The conductor of the bus was also injured.
Hundreds of armed men belonging to two factions of Achakzai tribe- Hamidzai and Ghaibizai tribe- exchanged fire over old enmity. Seven tribesmen died while twenty-five were injured.
A man axed to death his wife and her alleged paramour on suspicion of having illicit relations.
Abid Mahmood was found shot dead by his collegue, Sarfraz
A man was injured in Indian cross border shelling

Women and children held a demonstration on the Kohat-Bannu road to protest the power failures in the area by burning tyres and putting water filters on the main road, causing a blockade. The DCO, Tariq Hayat, brought the Pesco official and assured the protesters that smooth running of power would be seen.
Muhammad Ashraf and Muhammad Aslam were allegedly shot dead by Fayyaz and his accomplices over a land dispute.
11 more people were killed by Indian gunfire over the past two days.
A powerful explosion near the quarter of a railway police personnel damaged the rear wall of the quarters and also the window panes of nearby houses. No casualties were reported.
Two rival groups of a tribe clashed with each other over a piece of land.
Sher Ali Bugti, brother-in-law of Wadera Khan Muhammad Kalpar Bugti was shot dead by unidentified assailants. The reason behind the killing is not known.
2 groups of Domki tribe clashed over Karo Kari incident.

A large number of people of New Cloth Market protested against the non-supply of water in the area for the last three days. They burnt tyres and closed shops. A heavy contingent of the police and Rangers rushed to the area to control the situation.
Militants destroyed two shops after they planted a bomb in a motorcycle workshop. The workshop owner said he had no enmity with anyone.
the Sanda police recovered the body of a man from T-5 near the river Ravi. the body appeared to have drowned.

An explosion coccured at a concert where Sono Nigam was performing. According to initial reports, an explosive device was planted in a Suzuki Margalla. At least 4 other vehicles were damaged. According to a private television network, 2 people were killed.
Two groups of Janveri clan exchanged fire over a land dispute leading to the death of Maihar Ali Janveri.

SI Shafiullah and his unidentified companion were sprayed with bullets when their car slowed down at a speed breaker. Both of them died.; Follow-up: The companion was identified as Shafqat Javed, an auto electrician and resident of Qasba Colony.

The Indian Security Forces continued intensified and unprovoked firing on Zafarwal, Charwa, Bajwat, Chaprar, Harpal, Sucheetgarh, Bajragarhi and Shakargarh sector. As a result, the firing killed 2 goats,  badly damaged 2 houses and 3 tractors as well as distrupted the sowing of paddy crop. The Chenab Rangers did return the fire which forced the Indian army to flee towards their bunkers.

Three people were killed and seven others suffered injuries, three of them critical, in a clash between the Dogar and Mayo rival groups in the Gagar Sahari village over a tree-cutting dispute, when both groups exchanged fire with each other while men from the Dogar biradarie were cutting down trees.
Bullet-riddled bodies of two men were found in North Nazimabad on Monday. Their hands and legs were tied.
Muhammad Sharif was murdered for 'revenge of election rivalry'. Muhammad Hanif and his accomplices were arrested in connection with the murder.
The dead bodies of two young men wrre found who had been tortured before being shot.

Two Rangers, Pehlwan Khan and Sher Dad, were seriously injured when Indian forces fired across the Sialkot working boundary. According to official sources, they continued firing on Pakistani villages in Bajwat, Harpal, Sucheetgarh and Charwa Shakargah sectors of the Sialkot working boundary, thus badly disrupting the harvest of the wheat crop. When Chenab Rangers returned fire, 3 Indian soldiers were injured and then Indians retreated from their advanced positions.

Ali Raza was standing outside his house when he was hit by bullets. A protest rally was being staged by a religious outfit at the time but a link between the two is not explicitly stated and the police could not ascertain if Ali Raza was targeted or was just a victim of random firing. However, mourners at his funeral that was also attended by leaders of the Jaffaria Alliance Pakistan, demanded that the government make efforts to stop the targeted killing of members of their sect. Intermittent firing was witnessed following the funeral prayers. The police believe the reason behind the killing is to ignite sectarian violence.
Four people were injured in indiscriminate firing opened by three unidentified youngsters riding motorcycles in Gowalmandi. Police registered a case.
40 people were injured when PPP activists fired in self-defence on an angry mob of PML workers who wanted to set fire to the houses of two PPP leaders.
Two FC men were injured in an exchange of fire with armed tribesmen.
One person was killed and another was injured in an exchange of fire which took place between villagers and ten unidentified men who attacked the village near Aliabad.
Armed men attacked a public bus. As a result one passenger, identified as Shan-i-Zar sustained bullet injuries.
One person was injured in a high-intensity bomb blast in the Hamza mosque of Chakwal.
At least 14 people were killed and several were injured in a clash between Turi and Mangal tribesmen.
Police arrested three persons in a tractor-trolley in suspision of timber theft. However, the villagers attacked the police for arresting their fellows and the police rounded 5 villagers.
Two policemen were gunned down during routine patrol in the Kili Qambarani area when two unidentified men on a motorcycle opened fire on them and fled. Officials termed it a target killing.

Two activists of the Muttahida Qaumi Movement, Mirza Asif Baig and Naveed Murtaza were killed when their car was intercepted near the Sindh Government Hospital by unidentified men who sprayed them with bullets and fled. Both were rushed to the hospital and pronounced dead on arrival.

Militants shot dead a man suspected of spying for Pakistani and US authorities. The bullet-riddled body of Muhammad Jan Khan was found with a note written Pushto saying Khan had been spying for American and Pakistani troops in the area for a long time and had been under observation.
Two men were injured in a bomb explosion that unknown saboteurs had planted in a garbage dump.
A security guard was gunned down by two armed assailants in Sector F-10 on Monday
A worker of the MQM (afaq) was shot dead by unidentified assailants.

Armed men ambushed a police vehicle by opening indiscriminate fire. Police guards returned fire and injured a terrorist. The outlaws escaped to the Khrotabad area with police in pursuit. After heavy exchange of fire, one attacker was injured and succumbed to his injuries at the hospital. Another injured attacker escaped. Perves Rafi Bhatti DIG Quetta claimed it was a sectarian terrorist attack targeting the DSP as he was involved in uncovering the gang responsible for attacks in Quetta. DSP survived with injuries however three other policemen were killed; Follow up: An angry mob blocked Sabzal road in protest over police carrying out extra judicial killing of Abdul Karim. The police claim he was killed in an encounter for attacking the law enforcement.

According to the police, some youths tried to take over the Rehmatul-lil-Aalameen Mosque in New Karachi. However, the occupants resisted which resulted in an armed clash. There were at least 17 people injured and the police intervened and arrested 14 people of the Sipah-i-Sahaba Pakistan and Sunni Tehrik.
A person was shot at and injured by unidentied men in Jinnah Colony on Thursday.
A video shop was destroyed and three people were injured when a bomb exploded in the Shobra chowk.

An activist of the Muhajir Qaumi Movement-Haqiqi was killed  and about a dozen others were wounded when their convoy was fired upon by unidentified assaialants near Kala Board in Malir. Sources stated that the activists were returning from a protest demonstration. The Muttahida Qaumi Movemetn and Mohajir Qaumi Movement were both tryiing to register FIRs against each other as both claimed that the deceased belonged to their party.
A couple, Ali Muhammad and Sardaran Bibi, was gunned down while sleeping by unknown assailants. The police have not been able to ascertain the motive behind the murder.
Bomb explosion occurred near railway backyard on Friday.
One Mohammad Aslam was killed as a result of exchange of fire between two parties over a land dispute.

The body of a Lashari tribesman was found near the Haji Sajawal village. He was allegedly killed by Bhambro tribesmen during a clash between the Bhambhro and Lashari tribes over a land dispute. Following the recovery of the body, the police arrested 12 Bhambhro tribemen.

Qari Abdul Raziq-a young boy- was gunned down by Shah Mohammad, a member of a rival family. This father,Jahanzeb, and cousin, Nusrat, were injured in the attack. The two families had a property dispute.
security forces pounded militant hideouts in Cheenar, Kohay and Hashim areas of Charmang and destroyed 12 houses of suspected terrorists. 2 militants were arrested in Nawagai tehsil.
The buildings of two primary schools fo girls were blown up by militants.
three people were injured when an artillery shell hit the house of a relative of the militant Nazir Afridi.
Grain merchant, Deedar Ali, was shot dead by his cousin, Ghulam Abbas, with the help of two other relatives. He was killed over a dispute over a plot in Bado village.
A bomb exploded near the boundary wall of Jamaat-i-Islami headquarter Mansoora on Thursday. The bomb was placed on the backside of the outer-wall of the Jamaat's HQ
Two bullet-riddled bodies were found from the Manghab area of Turbat.
A girls' school in Wari area of Upper Dir district was burnt down by an unidentified gang. The watchman fired in the air to alert the area people.

Following the death of Ghulam Mustafa, a 9th class student who was runover by a speeding coach, students of the school boycotted classes, blocked the road, burnt tyres and completely destroyed the said coach. The police arrived and brought the situation under control before registering a case against the driver of the coach.

Two activists of MQM were killed and another was injured in Korangi \F\" Area on Sunday allegedly by MQM(Haqiqi). Police claims that 3 people were standing near a park in Korangi \"G\" Area when unidentified men opened fire on them on Sunday.The title suggests that 2 men were killed and two were injured, however the article accounts for only two deaths and one injury."

Six armed people shot dead an under-trial killer in police custody, Muhammad Ayub Manak, when the policemen were transporting him back from a court to the police station. The armed men intercepted the police van and attacked it, at which the police guards fled and the attackers brutally murdered the prisoner. The killing is belived to be revenge of the murder of Yasin Jataoi, allegedly murdered by the Manak clan.
A generator of the powerhouse was damamged when some people fired upon the plant.

A mob of industrial workers took out a protest on the second consecutive day against the killing of a factory worker more than 281 persons were injured and two were killed in clashes between protesters and police in various areas. The angry mob set fire to a petrol pump, residential quarters of the police force of D-type colony, 25 factories, nine private, four police and two WAPDA vehicles, a WASA warehouse, and records of the octroi post of Samundri Road, besides damaging more than 87 shops. They also attacked the 'dera' of local Mayor Sher Ali and damaged his car. The police fired tear gas shells and resorted to baton-charge in various parts.

Militants launched a rocket attack on Oblanki checkpost in Dosali area killing one soldier and injuring another. 15 rockets were fired on the checkpost followed by heavy pounding of assailants' positions with artillery by army.

Unidentified men attacked HaveldarZubair of Rangers and his companion, Lance Naik Rahat Khan. The latter was injured while the former was kidnapped and killed. His bullet riddled body was recovered from Shah Faisal colony.
More than 200 people were arrested during the long march called by the PDA against the government. Heavy teargas shelling and baton-charge was done against the protesters in Liaqat Bagh on Thursday.
three powerful blasts hit the Kalat area with brief intervals. The blasts were triggered by home-made bombs which were planted in the football stadium.

The wife of Sher Aman and her sister were going to Rashakai village when allegedly their opponents, Yaqub Khan and Mir Rehman opened fire at them killing her sister on the spot while she suffered injuries.

A JSQM worker was kidnapped from his home and was founf dead some time later. Police said that his body had been subjected to torture. Tension gripped the area after the killing and shopkeepers were forced to close down their shops.
An unidentified person fired at a police checkpost and fled.An ASI was killed and a constable was injured.

a strike was observed in Balochistan against the killing of the three Baloch leaders. A mob set a utility store on fire after looting it. They also tried to attack some government buildings but they were beaten back by security forces.
Security forces used heavy artillery to pound militant hideouts, after detecting movement of Taliban in the area.
Two policemen were shot dead when unidentified men opened fire on them. It is not known who the perpetrators behind the attack were.

Armed men on two motorcycles opened fire on Sher Ali and Naeem. Sher Ali, who was  a waiter at a hotel in Garden area, was killed while Naeem was injured. A taxi driver, identified as Khaista Khan, was also injured.
Barkat Shah, a police official, was shot and killed by unknown gunmen
Two missiles fired landed near the PAF airbase. According to the ISPR reports, four missiles were fired and could not have been done so by an individual and was therefore an organised crime.
Three unidentified men opened fire on a man in Sector 7-E, Orangi town, killing him on the spot. The political affiliation and reason behind the killing could not be ascertained.

There was a strike called by JSQM in protest against the arrest of the chairman, Bashir Khan Qureshi, and vice-Chairman, Dr. Niaz Kalani. A group of JSQM workers exploded crackers in Muzammil, damaging a sweet shop. The district police arrested JSQM leader, Ghulam Mustafa.

A teenanger was killed and eight others were wounded when a remote controlled device exploded at the Old Native Jetty's Bridge where hundreds of people mostly from the Shia community gathered for worship.
Gunmen kidnapped an iranian attache and killed his guard on Hayatabad township.
A day of mourning was called by MQM in Karachi as the renewed violence continued, although not linked to the shut down. A young man was found shot dead near Gharibabad in Malir.
A fifty year old man was found dead in Orangi Town. The police claimed he had been standing outside his house when unidentified men opened fire on him.
Angry protesters set ablaze two buses of the Pakistan Steel after removing the drivers and passengers.
Sher Ahmed, a policeman, suffered injury when he attempted to deactivate a rocket that was found in the city.

Two sub-inspectors and a constable were injured allegedly by villagers, during a raid on a house of a man for the recovery of an abducted girl, when the villagers attacked the police with axes, sticks, bricks and guns. The SHO also alleged that they tore up the uniforms of the police officials as well. Cases were registered against several villagers.
A woman was shot at and injured in Chak No. 1-Ford over a land dispute when several armed men opened fire on her and her father in law, who escaped unhurt.
an operation to clear the area from Daggar to the heights in the north led to militants suffering heavy casualties.

a young man, Junaid, was shot dead in Jhangirabad in Nazimabad by unknown persons near his house. The police said he was a former activist of the MQM, and that he was wanted in dozens of criminal cases.
The Allama Iqbal Sub-division office of Wapda was set ablaze in Unit no. 12, Latifabad.

Three people died when the explosives they were carrying on a bicycle exploded accidently when the bicycle hit a road bump. The police said that the three people were on their way to the 'Qul' of a slain SHO, where they planned to plant the bombs or attempt a suicide attack when the senior police officials arrived. Two of the victims, Adeel and Akhtar, were students of the Madarassa Azizul-Aloom and the third, Maqsood, belonged to the banned Lashkar-i-Jhangvi.  The police beleived that the prime target of the failed attack was the Sahiwal police chief Syed Javed Hussain Shah. The police then arrested 5 teachers and 40 students of the seminary (Madrassah).  Followup: The police has claimed to have found the mastermind behind the blast, named Qari Aneesur Rehman. They also were looking to capture the head of the Azizul Aloom seminary, and had managed to take into custody a fourth bomber who was going to be involved in the attack. Followup: The police claimed to have arrested the prime suspect of the Chichawatni blast after interrogating around 150 suspects and releasing 137 after premilinary investigation. Zahid Butt is said to be the name of the main accused.  Followup: Another Chichawatni blast suspect was arrested.
agents had been manhandeled at UC Rasool Bux Mari polling station, Kotdiji taluka.

A young man associated with a religious outfit was shot and killed by armed men on a motorbike. The Ahl-i-Sunnat Wal Jamaat claimed that the victim was associated with their party. Intermitted firing and arson activity was witnessed following the funeral which left a truck burnt in Al-Noor Society. The police believe the reason behind the killing is to ignite sectarian violence.
Acher Burgri was shot dead by unknown assailants.
Two people were killed and 10 were injured in unprovoked and indiscriminate firing by Indian troops across LoC in AJK.
The second bomb blast of the day destroyed a transformer and damaged six vehicles and injured as many as 9 people, including 2 Afghan refugees.
A badly decomposed body of a 65 year old was recovered from his house in Islampura. Doctors say the man died 15 days ago.

Armed men on a motorbike opened fire on the car of loca PML-N leader Sardar Abdul Aziz Umrani, killing him and his guard and injuring 2 other guards. Police say that personal enmity might have played a role in the incident.
Unidentified people hurled a hand grenade on the house of a retired railway officer, Nazir Ahmed, killing his son as a result. BLA claimed the responsibility for the attack.
The bullet riddled body of a young man was found. The victim's family lodged an FIR agaist Mohajir Qaumi Movement's workers. However, it was not mentioned if MQM was directly responsible.
A man and a woman were axed to death by the husband of the woman on the pretext of Karo-kari in the Daro Khoharo village.
A stage drama artist, Shazia Kanwal, was slaughtered by an unknown assailant in her house.
Abid Hussain, a WAPDA official was gunned down while he was on his way home.

The activists of IJT took out a procession from Punjab University's Old Campus to Regal in order to protest against the war on the Taliban. The IJT workers burnt flags of the US during the announcement that protests will continue throughout the country.
a Frontier Corps was killed and two others injured in gunbattle with tribesmen. Exchange of heavy fire including rockets took place between the two sides.
Militants attacked a security checkpost leading to an exchange of fire between them and security forces. 3 militants were killed while 1 security man sustained injuries.
A man was assassinated when unidentified gunmen opened fire on him on Sariab Road while he was on his bike. A passer-by was also injured and he later succumbed to his injuries.
As violence spread across Karachi in reaction to the attack on an MQM office, armed motorcyclists shot and killed Saeed Khan, a cobler who was working at his stall.
The dead body of a young girl was found in Raiwand City on Monday. Body was without head and right hand.
A schoolboy who had gone missing on Nov 11 was found dead in a 50 feet high water tank.
A police constable of the Tipu Sultan police station was gunned down in UP, New Karachi while on his way to the police station.
In Mardan, nine people were injured in firing between two rival groups in two separate incidents during the wheel-jam strike.

A police inspector, Chaudhry fayyaz Ahmed, was going to his office at Brewery road when his vehicle came under fire. One police constable dies while the inspector and his guard were injured. BLA claimed responsibility for the attack.

Majlis-i-Aza was in progress in the village Imam Bargah when a fire erupted in a cottage in a nearby graveyard. Those present at the Majlis thought that someone had deliberately set the cottage on fire to disrupt the gathering. As a result the security forces of the Imam Bargah started aerial firing. This in turn infuriated some people from the other sect who started firing in the air. The police reached the spot and arrested 14 men from both sides.
A militant hurled a hand grenade at a checkpost and fled, only to be chased and killed by the police. The original grenade attack left a constable and a bystander injured.
20 people were injured in a blast took place at Urdu Bazaar on Wednesday. Locals are saying that the blast may be due to the heavy gas inside the drain. 3 people are still missing.
A woman was injured due to Indian shelling along LoC in Muzaffarabad(reported) on Monday
Six security personnel were injured and one vehicle was completely destroyed when a convoy hit a roadside bomb in the Spin Qabar area of Sipah while on routine patrol.

Four people were injured in a clash between the police and participants of a religious procession when the Chelum procession was pelted with stones by unknown persons, a clash ensued. Some of the processionists attacked the police contingent. Later, the police resorted to baton-charge and tear gas shelling to disperse the unruly mob.
Two blasts took place in the main bazaar of Kamoke, killing three people and injuring 25 others. The blasts took place at a 10-minute interval.
During a strike against the killings in Sindh, four masked men entered a school and opened fire. A teacher was injured.
A personnel of the Balochistan Reserve Police was injured when some armed men opened indiscriminate fire on them which they later returned.
An MQM (Afaq) member was shot dead
a youth stabbed his sister to death over suspicions of her having illicit relations with a man at Chak 22.

Two sisters were reportedly murdered by their brother for having developed illicit relations with some people of their village. They exchanged hot words with their brother, who then locked them in a room and killed them.
Militants destroyed two bridges in Shalobar, causing suspension of traffic between the area and other parts of Bara.

At least 12 army officials were killed and several others injured in a suicide attack at the heart of Kohat Cantonment area when a 15-17 year old boy made a dash towards officials returning to their barracks and blew himself up.

On a tip-off regarding the presence of militants, a police party led by an SHO cordoned off the area after spotting a suspicious car. The occupants of the car opened fire at the police which led to an exchange of fire in which a constable and two militants were killed while another constable was injured.
Gwadar saw outbreak of violent protest shortly after funeral prayers of Nawab Akbar Bugti.
FC personnel on patrol were attacked with a remote-control roadside bomb. 2 FC personnel were killed.

In the aftermath of the killing of 6 MQM-H workers in an attack on 'Peeli Kothi', incidents of violence were reported from various areas of Karachi. A bus of route no 52-A was set on fire by armed men.
A person was found shot dead in his North Nazimabad house on Monday
