At least 50 people were killed and some 200 wounded afer fighter jets bombed a village market near Mirali Town. 12 bombs were dropped that mainly targeted the small market. According to Military spokesman Maj-Gen Waheed Arshad, the number of militants killed in 3 days of fighting was approximately 150, and the army's casualities were 45.
Two people were killed and three were injured due to Indian shelling in Leepa valley on saturday
one person was killed and eight others were injured when two rival groups, Ayub and Nazir groups, exchanged fire in Burki, over an old enmity.
3 persons killed a boy, Bashir Khan. The murder was a follow-up to a dispute that had taken place between the victims and the killers.
a man, Sajjad, was outside his house in Rakser Lane, when unknown persons opened fire at him and fled.
A person was found dead in Defence area on Sunday. Police claimed that he was strangled
A man was injured by a bullet Phuleli village
a man was found dead in a gutter in I-14 Sector.

Approximately 100 inhabitants of a Kutchi Abadi in Sector G-8 clashed with the police during a protest demonstration. 3 women tried to self-immotate themselves but the police stopped them, while others started pelting the police with stones. They were protesting against a recent operation in the kutchi abadi in which the enforcement directorate of the CDA had razed some 'illegal encroachments'.
Nazakat Hussain, a salesman, was shot dead people travelling in a taxi that targeted him.
Some unidentified men made a  \ murderous attempt \" on the life of Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs, Mohammad Hanif Khan. The Minster survived but a few PPP workers got bullet wounds."

Following the murder of a young MQM activist in Gulistan-i-Jauhar, tension spread in the Gulshan-i-Iqbal locality and bus was reportedly set on ablaze near Kiran Hospital just shortly after the killing.
According to locals, suspected militants planted explosive devices in a girls government school, which was blown up. Two rooms and a head master's office were destroyed in the building.
Two women were injured in landmine explosions.
Mohajir Qaumi Movement (MQM) activists allegedly set the vehicles on fire in Nabi Baksh, Risala and Johrabad, respectively.
A bomb exploded near the Pabbi Railway station in front of a public call office, killing one person and injuring three others.
One soldier was injured while defusing a landmine near the Chashmai Bridge.
a man was injured when some men on a motorbike hurled a grenade at a clinic in Dera Bugti town.
In a bid to protest against the house robbery in which a shopkeeper was killed and his brother was injured, people resorted to brick batting as the police reached national highway on Tuesday.

A blast took place in a Gujranwala-bound bus near the Alim bypass. Two passengers were killed on the spot while 3 others succumbed to their injuries in the hospital. A total of 15 people were injured in the blast.
The strife-hit areas of Karachi witnessed renewed violence, as armed men killed a restaurant owner and injured his employee in Gulistan-i-Jauhar in Block 17.

Three constables were injured in an explosion in the office of senior superintend police in the district courts. The bomb exploded when the SSP was addressing a press conference and his office was completely destroyed.
During a strike, called by MQM-H, the zonal office of the MQM(A) was attacked. Armed men opened indiscriminate fire at the office but no one was injured.
Two missiles were fired at a village causing panic in the area.No one was hurt.

Chaudhry Zahid informed Rescue 15 that there was a suspicious bag lying in the Sabzi Market and people were running around in panic. Bomb experts defused the locally made, 1 kg explosive device. However, according to the Deputy Superintendent of the Police, I-9, Ishaq Waraich, the police spotted the bag and the bomb experts later defused it.
Pakistani Army repulsed an attempted attack on a Pakistani post by Indian army. Heavy casulaties were inflicted.
Six people were shot at and injured in an exchange of fire between two groups in Shaheenabad locality.

A mob of mourners (moharram related) attacked and ransacked offices of railway officials and pelted trains with stones to protest against the massive delay in the arrival of trains. The mourners had arrived in the thousands to attend the famous Shama Gul mourning procession of 9th Muharram in Rohri.

An office of the Health Department's Family Planning Project was set ablaze by unknown people, who sprayed the walls with kerosene and set it on fire. The entire office and family planning medicines and contraceptives were gutted.

A large number of people mourning the death of a slain religious leader Maulana Hassan Jan drove away Interior Minister Aftab Ahmad Khan Sherpao and Chief Minister Akram Khan Durrani when they came to offer their condolences. The angry people started throwing their shoes at the political figures and later pelted stones, forcing the political figures to leave. They also smashed the windowpanes of the stadium.

More than a dozen people were injured when police and rangers tear-gassed and resorted to baton-charge during a protest against water scarcity in Vehari, under which the protesters chanted slogans and later lit bonfires on the roads.
Villager Noor Alam was injured in firing by Indian troops from across the LoC
A senior anti-government lawyer, Raja Mohammed Riaz, who hailed from Pind Dadan Khan, was shot dead by armed assailants in what was believed to be a target killing case.

Over 30 people were injured, and more than 500 detained when protestors, comprising of lawyers, political activists and general people, tried to gather in front of the Supreme Court to show solidarity with the sacked Chief  Justice of Pakistan.
Two persons were wounded in shooting incidents in North Karachi.
gas pipeline was blown up disrupting supply to several areas including a Sui plant from the Koh gas field.
A police official was gunned down when armed men on a motorbike opened fire on him on Jahangir Road.

Sarwar Bibi was killed and seven others were injured when Indian trops opened unprovoked firing on the civilian area in Poonch Sector.The firing continued for two hours and was countered by the Pakistan Army.;Follow-up:Kala Khan ,an infant Nadeem and Safaida Begum also passed away of their injuries in the hospital on Thursday.Follw-up: Mukhtar Begum also died of her injuries in the hospital on Friday.
A government middle school was blown up in Akkakhel when a huge quantity of explosives, planted by militants, exploded during the night.
2 people were injured in a clash between groups of Qadianis and Muslims in Chawinda Town on Saturday.
a primary school for boys and a basic health center were set on fire by unidentified persons. The militants planted explosives at both the buildings.

Three students were injured in a clash between IJT and APMSO activists. The violence started at Urdu Science College when APMSO students did not allow IJT students to get their admit cards. The violence spread to National College and as a result three students were injured.

A roadside bomb killed a tribal elder, Nawabzada Shamsul Wahab Khan, and his driver, and injured two of his body guards. The relatives of the deceased said they had no enmity when anyone, so the reasons behind the attack were not clear, or even certain that it was a targetted attack.
Several people were hurt in an armed clash between Qandhari and Baghlan tribes of Afghan refugees over food distribution in the refugee camp.
Following the strike call given by MQM steering committee, armed youths took to the streets and resorted to violence. A vehilcle of the Irrigation Department was set on fire.

A strike was called out by the opposition party against the 'mini budget' announced by the governor of State Bank of Pakistan. PML activists, who had planned demonstrations in the city, set on fire tyres and blocked traffic at several places. Reports said that they had smashed windscreens of some passenger wagons. The police had to intervene to restore traffic.

There was a clash between two groups of the district council after Abdul Aziz Bhambro of Khairpur Dost Panel, who is a claimant of the Naib Nazim post, and his supporters occupied the office of the acting Naib Nazim, namely Shafi Mohammad Chandio. The district Nazim said that the rival members illegally opened the Naib Nazim's office even though the Supreme Court had issued a stay order in favour of Mr. Chandio. The PML-F MNA said that the ADP attacked the KDP members. the PPP MPA said that the issue will be resolved in the Sindh Assembly.
unidentified assailants killed a faith-healer at his workplace in A-2 Sector of Township.
A remote controlled bomb, that was planted near an unmanned Khasadar post, was detonated when a passenger vehicle was passing by. At least 6 people, including the driver, were injured.

5 militants were killed when secuirty forces attacked their hideouts in Kanju area of Swat. this was one of the incidents for which the army has claimed that 23 terrorists were killed and 5 were captured during operationsin Swat and Dir on 1-jul-09 and 2-jul-09.

A militant, Jamshed of the Warha Bainai area, was injured along with a bystander when a bomb he was planting exploded prematurely. The bomb was being planted at the shop of Lutaf Gul, who had joined the ANP 2 months before the incident. This was the 3rd attack on Mr. Gul's property as his hujra and his CNG station had been targeted earlier.
4 people were killed in US drone attack near Ghoroski on Friday. According to the sources there were also some foreigners among dead.

Militants attacked an FC checkpost to which the FC personnel in the area responded with fire. In the ensuing clash, 2 FC men were injured while two others were kidnapped by the militants. The FC launched a search operation in the area soon after the incident.
The dead body of one Abdul Ghafoor was found in a sugar cane filed. His mother alleged that two people from her village were behind the murder. No arrests were made.

Supporters of APMSO and NSF had an armed clash on campus which left 3 students injured. The clash erupted after one group accused the other of removing material from that group's notice board. Both groups accused each other of using firearms.

8 people were killed and 38 were injured when a bomb went off infront of the office of the PML-N district president Raja Akhtar Ali in Gunj market. Seven shops and power supply lines were damaged. DCO Syed Mohsin Shah said 20 people had suffered injuries. a man was arrested after the blast.
Suspected militants used local made bombs to blow up an electricity tower. This caused an increase in the duration of loadshedding
A riot occurred between PML N and PML Q supporters after PML N candidate Tirmazee was defeated with a margin of 139 votes by PML Q candidate Shahjehan Yousaf.
The dead body of an unidentified man was found by the police in a vacant house. The Naib Nazim had informed the police of the location of the body.
a clash between ADP and KDP workers was reported at Mehrab Sodhro polling station of Thari Mirwah.
A time bomb exploded off in Tall Bazaar on Friday. However no loss was reported.
Muhammad Sultan stabbed his married sister to death on suspicion of her having a loose character. No arrests were made.

A local zamindar and his wife were gunned down by unidentified persons in Mod village of Pano Aqil taluka.  The armed persons reportedly barged into the houe of Qadir Bux and tried to overpower the inhabitants.  When they resisted, the intruders opened fire, killing the husband and wife.  No other details were reported, but nothing was reported stolen.
The bullet-riddled body of the former General Manager of National Highway Authority was found in the boot of his abandoned car. The motive behind the killing could not be ascertained.
A security guard was shot at by unidentified armed assailants riding a car. The guard was injured. The motive behind the shooting is not known.

a civilian driver was killed when his truck which was part of a military convoy was blown up in a roadside explosion. Security forces retaliated resulting in an exchange of fire. Some militants managed to escape.
The headless body of a person was found from a car in Nazimabad on Thursday. The victim was kidnapped and then murdered.
Saboteurs fired rockets at the Khuzdar cantonment area. The rockets landed in an open area and did not explode. The office of the secret agency was apparently the target of the attack.
Two 'snipers' opened fire in front of a polices station and a cloth shop, spreading panic in the area. No loss of life or property was reported.

people brought out a procession on the APC strike call against the carpet bombings on Iraq. The police lathi-charged the rally and a large number of people received injuries. More than a 100 people were arrested.
JSQM activists pelted stones over traffic on the Nawabshah-Kumb road, as a result, it was closed for 8 hours
Unknown armed men opened indiscriminate firing in Nazimabad and other areas of Karachi on Saturday.

Following an attack my militants on a checkpost, the military launched strikes to target militants. 30 militants were killed, 14 injured and 6 arrested when security forces, backed by tanks, helicopters and artillery attacked their positions.
Two people were injured in a grenade attack on a truck near Hazaganji. Police said the grenade was hurled at an FC vehicle but it hit the truck which was passing through the area.
Mushtaq Magsi shot dead his niece, Nihala, and her alleged paramour, Salahuddin, in Rasool Abad village. Mushtaq later surrendered to the police.
Two power pylons were destroyed by unknown militants in Gulo Khan Village on Wednesday. Bomb Disposal Squad Official claimed that 8 bombs were planted out of which 6 went off.
Two people were killed and two others were injured in the Indian shelling from across the LoC in the Chakothi sector.

The body of an unidentified man was found. His hands were tied behind his back, there were several torture marks on his body, and he had bullet wounds on his forehead. According to the police, he seemed to be Afghani and in his 40s. They thought that he was probably killed in some other area and brought there.
Wazeer Khan and Tahir Punjabi, both ANP activists, were sprayed with bullets by armed motorcyclists while they were standing outside a snooker club.
firing by Indian troops on border villages across Working Boundary
Following a firing incident in the market place, local traders and shopkeepers pulled down their shutters, blocked the main road and set tyres on fire to protest the incident.
Two missiles fired by a US drone on a compound killed 10 suspected militants.
An unidentified body of a woman in her late 20s was found near Abdullah Gabol Goth. The victim was strangled, and the police claimed that she looked like a Seraiki-Sindhi woman.
Reports say that sajjad, tasadduq and razzaq shot dead shot dead ramzan and injured his brother. No durther details are given
On the second day of a renewed wave of violence that police saw blended with 'ethnic colour', as two men were found shot dead near the zoological garden along the walls of the zoo.
President of MSF Nisar Gujjar was gunned down in Choona Mandi on monday allgedly by Fazil Dar who is the owner of gambling den
The body of an unidentified person was found in baghbanpura area on Tuesday. Authorities said that the victim had a head injury
A head constable was killed and two policemen were injured when some militants attacked a checkpost in Daulatpura area on Thursday. Police retaliated and claimed that one militant was also killed.

An unidentified youth was found dead in a garbage dump in Block 8, Azizabad. His throat was slit and he had multiple stab wounds. According to the police, his body was two or three days old and he was wearing a shirt and trousers.
Shamim Bibi was killed by her cousin, Riaz, who suspected that she had developed 'illicit relations' with someone.

Security forces and police arrested 10 suspected militants and blew up six houses during a joint operation in Morani area of Lower Dir. The operation was conducted in the backdrop of growing incidents of torching schools and other government buildings in the area.
2 people were killed and 9 were injured, including four security personnel, when a remote controlled bomb was exploded on a Frontier Corps vehicle.
A guard of the Habib Bank Limited was killed and two others were wounded in an attack on the branch.

Unknown miscreants fired over 20 rockets and mortar shells onto township from mountains in the south of Mand township. At least 6 rockets exploded in the residential areas and 1 of them hit the house Mohammad Rafiq, resulting in the death of his son, Altaf, and injuring 3 others. A few rockets and mortar shells also exploded near the FC fort, while 1 exploded inside FC fort. 2 other rockets exploded near Tehsil offices causing small damage to the building. No person or group has accepted the responsibility for the attack so far. Provincial Home Minister Mir Shoaib Nausherwani and Federal Minister for Education Zubaida Jalal suspect it is an attack by people who oppose the development of the province. Officials say that the house of Federal Education Minister Zubaida Jalal was the target and was not damaged.
a moazzin and the son of a prayer leader were shot and wounded in an attack in the back of an Imambargah.

seven people two of them children and one woman were killed and 21 injured in a clash between Bangash and Malikhel tribes over distribution of irrigation water near the Pakistan Afghanistan border in Kurram agency. Heavy weapons and rockets were used in the exchange of fire.; the death toll in the clash between Bangash and Malikhel rises to 24 as two people died in the hospital. meanwhile, the Malikhel and Bangash tribes handed over 20 tribesmen each to the authorities through the efforts of the grand jirgawhich had brokered a truce between them till Aug 18, when it would meet again to decide the water dispute.
Four people were hurt when Khoso Community attacked a rival communtiy over a row on division of irrigation water.

40 students were arrested by the Karachi police when they went to the Assembly building to press for their demands, but before they got out of their buses they were lathi-charged. later Students of Agriculture University Tandojam staged a demonstration at the campus and boycotted classes to protest against this.
11 people were injured in a clash between PPP workers and police during the long march against the government on G.T Road on Thursday.
According to police the 22 year old activist of the Sunni Tehreek was kidnapped and his bullet-ridden body was found from Orange Street, Garden. The body bore five bullet wounds.

A shootout between two rival gangs of dacoits near Baseerpur(Depalpur Tehsil) left two outlaws dead on Friday. One of them identified as Mehr Aslam Garji,wanted in 135 cases of murder,decoity and high way robbery
Attack on a checkpost was carried out with rocket launchers and mortar bombs by bugti outlaws.
Indian forces did shelling in several villages of Leepa Sector on Monday. However no casuality was reported
Three people were killed and three children injured when unidentified gunmen opened indiscrimnate fire on the house of one, Bashirullah Bandlani. The reason behind the attack was not specified.
Four people were injured in a grenade attack in Satellite town.
Four young men riding motorcycles smashed the windows of Sadaf Hospital in Liaquatabad and fired shots into the air, causing a scare.  All four fled.

Zakir Zakakhel group and Khalid Khan group clashed over increase in parking fees, decided by jirga of local elders. Violating the decision of jirga supporters of Khalid group rampaged the office of Zakir group and beat up their supporters. People of Zakir group fired in the air and blocked the roads and abducted around 50 Kughakhel tribesmen. the Khugakhel tribe which owns the coach stand in Torkham has called a jirga of local elders to review the situaton.

Police resorted to aerial firing and used tear gas to disperse 600 people who attacked the Hesco office as a result of power supply being disrupted. They chanted slogans, set fire to the SDO-3 office and later tried to set ablaze the main Hesco office on the Minara Road.
A person was shot dead by unknown men near LMC Hospital Hyderabad on Monday

Helicopter gunships shelled suspected militant hideouts in Anjani area of Orakzai, killing 16 militants, destroying four camps, seven vehicles, an oil depot, the largecompound belonging to local Taliban commander Maulana Yar Mohammad.
Security forces killed a militant and arrested two of them after they attacked on a military convoy in Shee kallay area of darra Adam Khel.
a passenger was killed an 35 others were injured when a bomb placed in the Quetta bound Bolan Mail exploded. The Baloch Republican Army claimed responsibility for the attack.
At least 20 militants and their two senior commanders were killed in an air strike in the Peochar area of Swat.

A youth organisation, Pasban, staged a demonstration outside the Karachi Press club against the indecent remarks made about Pakistanis by a US attorney. They also burnt effigies of Clinton, Benazir and Nawaz Sharif.
Three people, including two women, were shot at and injured over a matrimonial dispute.
Ethnic violence that started in Khawaja Ajmer Nagari and later in Paposh Nagar, also spread to Liaquatabad where 2 people were stabbed and wounded while another was shot at and wounded.
A 70 year old candidate for general councillor, Ghazi Abul Shakoor, was shot dead in Pak Colony. He was attacked by two motorcyclists at a bakery.
The decomposed body of a man was found from central drain in Nishtar colony on Thursday. There were signs of torure on his body.
Faiz Gul Mohammad, a resident of Lyari, was shot dead while he was on his way home.

Violence, that started with the killing of senior MQM activist Shafiq Ahmed Ajmairi, continued as two men on a motorbike stopped outside a park and opened indiscriminate firing at the people inside. Salman Ishaq was killed while two people, Nasim Khatoon and Abdul Aziz, were injured.
Two unidentified people shot Zulfikhar Ali while he was sleeping on the street. He sustained serious injuries and died in the hospital.
Two people were killed and another was injured in a clash between two rival groups led by rivals Sohney Khan and Rana Akram.
Officials stated that security forces attacked and cleared the areas of Mamari, Shedakhel and Merikhel, killing nineteen militants with heavy artillery.
A man was killed in overnight firing by the Indian forces from across the LoC in Lawat, Neelum.

2 unidentified men on a motorcycle attacked a police official, Haider Beg. He was an active member of the 1992 operation clean-up launched by the then interior minister Naseerullah Babar. He earned fame and was granted promotion for his performance in the arrest of those allegedly involved in burning of the national flag. The other two polic officials who were famous for the operation, Inspector Taufiq Zahid and Inspector Zeeshan Kazmi, were both also murderd on 23-Apr-04 and 14-Oct-03 respectively.

Two soldiers were killed while another was injured when an improvised explosive device was detonated just a military convoy was passing by in the Gandao area. Security forces cordoned off the area and resorted to indiscriminate firing, which resulted in the death of four militants and caused injuries to six others.
Bodies of two young men were found stuffed in gunny bags from an isolated place in Nazimabad. Each had a single bullet to the head with torture marks on the body.

The Masih Development Council has condemned the firing at the residence of of a member of Minicipal Committee allegedly by an MPA in which eight people were injured in Sheikhupura. As the original incident was not reported, the details are being taken from this incident.
Nine rockets were fired on checkpost of Frontier Corps in Pirkoh gasfield area. However, no casualties were reported.
Zafar Hussain allegedly had relations with Sajjad's wife and to take revenge Sajjad and 4 accomplices picked up Zafar's mother and wife, disrobed them and dragged them on the ground.
A person was stabed to death by unidentified men in Rasheed Colony on Tuesday.

Unidentified criminals shot dead a lawyer in his office. The lawyer, Tariq Gill, was at his office when two motorcylists reported asked if the lawyer was in his offfice. Upon receiving an affirmative, the men opened fire on his office, killing him on the spot. The motive behind the murder was yet to be determined by the police.

Muhammad Azam Khan Hoti, a joint candidate of PML and ANP  for provincial assembly elections survived an assasination attempt when unidentified gunmen fired on his procession. Two people died and six others were injured.
A man, 48, was found dead on a mountain side in Sino village, some 135km from Skardu.

Protesters surrounded the Kasurpura police station and pelted stones at police officials and blocked roads by placing burning tyres on them. They were protesting against the death of a man in police custody which they alleged was a result of severe police torture. The police, however, claimed that the man committed suicide by using the gun of an ASI.  The enraged protesters also set ablaze two police vans and threw fire balls inside the Ravi Road and police station. The police resorted to mild baton charge to disperse the demonstrators.
Contingent of the paramilitary force was attacked by heavy gunfire and shelling of rocket propelled grenades by assailants belonging to the neighbouring Balochistan
Militants set on fire the Government High School, Bandai.
Hundreds of Jafria Students' Organisation members protested against the sacrilege of the shrine of Hazarat Ali in Iraq by US-led coalition forces. They burnt the US flag at Market Chowk.
Sporadic clashes between the militants and the security forces continued as 13 bodies were found in Swat. Military also thwarted the militants attempt to take over the Kabal policestation.
2 people were killed in a clash between two groups of Samtio Tribe in over a land dispute Samtio Village on tuesday
One, Zulfiqar, stoned his sister and cousin to death on suspicion of them having bad character in Chak No. 245 GB.
Four Bugti tribesmen were injured when a bomb exploded in Sui.
Militants attacked a checkpost in the Jagzai area of Mamond. Security forces retaliated and killed two militants in the ensuing clash.
During another raid a clash ensued and two Jatoi members were killed and three injured by Maher tribesmen.

After the death of a sub-inspector, many workers of the MQM Haqiqi were arrested which resulted in rioting and arsony in the areas of Malir, Malir City, Khokhrapar, Model Colony. Angry youths set fire to a Mazda, a taxi and a suzuki in Moeenabad area.

Five tribesmen were injured in a landmine blast in Dera Bugti when a bus carryiing security guards and close relatives of Wadera Abdul Rehman hit the mine. Police said the landmine was planted there to attack Wadera Abdul Bugti, who was not in the vehicle at the time.
As part of the on-going violence in Karachi, an unidentified body was found in Lyari river and the body bore torture marks.
Abdul Hameed and Mohammad Anwar were shot at and injured. No further details were given.
3 persons were injured in Indian shelling across LoC in different sectors of kotli district on Saturday
One person was killed and another injured during the gunbattle between two groups of the Jakhrani tribe, near Bugti Colony.
Two rival groups of the Mari tribe exchanged fire. A man, Tariq, was killed and two others sustained injuries in the crossfire.

Yar Mohammad Umrani was tracked down and shot dead by 3 of his relatives- Ghaffar, Alam and Imam Bukhsh Umrani- as he had been declared Karo by his relatives 8 months ago. His body was sent to his native village Ali Jan Umrani, Garhi Khero taluka, Jacobabad district.
A labourer was shot dead by two men for having illicit relations with a woman from their family.
a rocket exploded on Sirki road. Half an hour later another rocket was fired which exploded in the cantonment.

An 8 year old boy, Hazarat Ali, was caught in the cross-fire between a law enforcement agency and a suspected terrorist. The law enforcement agency was raiding Chaman township to arrest one Mohammad Azam.
The bomb disposal squad received a call stating that a bomb was lying in the area of Ainger-khawara. They reached the spot and successfully defused the bomb.
6 rockets were fired at an FC checkpost in Fazalchal. There was no casualty or damage.

Two groups of people belonging to '2 different schools of thought' clashed with each other in a mosque after a heated exchange of words, leaving 6 people injured. Officials cited an old dispute between the two groups over the control of the mosque as the main reason behind the incident. Initially the groups resorted to using sticks and iron rods but later one group used weapons after which a police team showed up and rescued the people stuck inside the mosque. The police also picked up 45 people but after screening only officially arrested 24 of them.
An official of KMC  was shot dead by unidentifed gunmen in his car near his house.
20 students were arrested after they protested against the entry of an SDM in the examination hall. They tried to block a road and were teargassed and baton charged.

Unknown persons fired nine rockets at an FC checkpost and a telephone exchange in the Kohlu area. According to sources the rockets exploded with brief intervals near the checkpost and telephone exchange, spreading panic.

The Lal Masjid 'brigade' made four policemen hostage, accusing them of spying for the government and raising the fear of a possible crackdown.They threatened the government of suicide attacks all over the country if they tried to conduct any sort of operation against the mosque clerics.
troops used artillery and shelled the positions of militants who attacked 2 forts in Jandola with rockets.

About a hundred supporters of the NSF organized a rally to protest against the closure of DMC and SMC campuses and the presence of police on campuses. The protesters disrupted traffic and stopped a KTC bus before deflating its tyres and setting it on fire. This was part of their general protest campaign against the interference of police in academic institutions.
Political tehsildar Yar Muhammad Wazir escaped unhurt in a roadside bomb blast which damaged his vehicle in Tangi area of Bajaur. No group has claimed responsibility for the attack.
Some unidentified persons shot dead one housewife, Mukhtaran, while she was sleeping in her house.
A suicide bomber rammed an explosive laden jeep into the Charbagh police station killing four policemen and three others.
an exchange of fire between the security forces and the tribesmen was reported in the area. However, no casualties were reported and the militants managed to escape.
Traders observed a complete shutterdown in protest against load-shedding and withdrawl of subsidies. Some of the tradrs burnt bills and raised slogans against the government.

A clash between the Jagirani and the Jatoi tribes occurred, killing one and injuring another. According to police sources, Lal Dino- the landlord of the village- was attacked by armed men who opened indiscriminate firing. The two tribes were at war for the last year and so far 13 people have been killed over an affair related to karo-kari.
A 20-year-old man was allegedly shot at over a family dispute.  He died on the spot and the killer escaped.

Four people were killed and seven injured when two groups of the Wattu tribe clashed over disputed property. According to details, one group headed by Mohammad Ramzan attacked his rival Shamand's dwelling. A clash ensued. The police could not arrest anyone.

At least ten suspected militants were killed in an exchange of fire with the security forces during a search operation in Shaoobar area  in Bara tehsil. Three houses of commanders were also destroyed and 87 militants were reportedly taken into custoy.

All tyre shop owners and residents of the area held a protest demonstration against the killing of two shopkeepers. The unruly mob gathered at the National Highway, blocked traffic, pelted passing vehicles with stones, smashed their windsheilds, burnt tyres and kiosks. Police gathered and tried to stop the commotion, and they were pelted with stones as well. Police had to resort to firing at the protesters, injuring five of them.

ASI Zahoor Ahmed, who was travelling on his motorcycle, was stopped by two men on a motorbike who shot and killed him before fleeing the scene. An official claimed that he was targeted because of 'his recent professional assignments'.
Naimat Habib, a resident of Orangi Town, was gunned down by a man on a motobike while the former was on his way back from a relative's house.
A man was wounded in 'Sniper firing' in Johrabad.

the caretaker of an Imambargah was killed by armed men in a busy market. A suicide bomber ran into the mourning procession and blew himself up. Angered by the attack a large number of protesters resorted to aerial firing, pelted vehicles with stones, ransacked shops and torched buses. They also erected road blocks by burning tyres and fired on the police. A curfew was imposed and a shoot-on-sight order was issued to prevent further unrest. Police and locals blame sectarian extremists, but no one has claimed responsibility for the incident.
A woman was injured in Indian shelling along LoC in Tatta Pani sector on Saturday

Law enforcement personnel resorted to baton-charge, tear gas shelling and firing when inmates at the Central Prison resisted a search launched by the jail authorities to uncover anything illegal in the possession of the prisoners. The inmates fought back with bricks and stones. The clash left almost a dozen people, including 4 law enforcement personnel, injured. A large number of political activists of Mir Murtaza Bhutto group and Jeay Sindh group were incarcerated in this particular prison and the recent transfer of some of them had already created unrest among the prisoners.

Three constables guarding a railway bridge on the Haro river were shot dead. Their bodies were found at a place about 15 km away from the town. Another constable deputed at the post was on leave and the head constable in charge was also not there. The officials said it did not appear to be an incident of terrorism because the bridge and railway line had not been harmed. It appeared to be a case of target killing.
A man was shot and killed in Peerabad.
training centers of commanders Lal Din, Said Jalil and Mian Said Liaq in Peochar were destroyed.
A man was injured in a shooting incident in Orangi Extension.
Indian shelling across the Line of Control. Details are not available.
The bullet riddled body of a man who had been kidnapped a few hours earlier was found near a plaza.
A person was found dead in the Shrine of Data Ganj Buksh on Monday
Balochistan Secretary Mines and Minerals, Jan Mohammad Dashti and his driver were injured when they were ambushed in their car.
a rickshaw driver was killed while his female passenger was injured when an unknown assailant opened fire on them and then fled. Motives for the killing ar unknown.
One person was injured when local Taliban attacked a music function held to mark the wedding. Taliban had warned family of Akhtar Zaman Bhittani against holding a music function at the wedding.
Two police men were injured \ in shhoting\". Thevreport does not give any other details."

Four unidentified armed men ambushed a vehicle of landlord Makhdum Sajjad Usmani, injuring him and killing his guard. Sadar police ruled out any sectarian factor saying that the assailants seemed to be dacoits. Makhdum Sajjad Usmani is Chairman Sunni Council.

Two MQM workers , Imtiaz and Ghulam Hussain, who also worked for the fire department, were kidnapped and their bullet riddled bodies were found later.MQM members alleged that PSF was responsible for the killing.However, the police did not confirm.

A day of mourning was called by MQM in Karachi as the renewed violence continued, although not linked to the shut down. A milkman was shot and killed when armed persons ambushed him and opened fire just as he was leaving his farm near Murghi Khana stop in Landhi.
A man was shot dead over a land dispute.

a Haqiqi worker Mohammad Nauman was killed and his mother and brother were injured when some men on a motorcycle opened fire on the taxi they were travelling in near Gulshan Qadri in Malir City.Police confirmed that 10 political workers had been killed since Saturday in fighting among different political groups, which began 5 days ago.
A four year old child was killed and six others injured in a shoot out between two rival groups.
Two officials of the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commision were kidnapped in Badin area.
One person was injured in Indian shelling along LoC in Nikayal Sector on Saturday

Supporters of two rivals in the local body elections opened fire on each other after an altercation over depositing the forms first to a mobile team of Nadra for getting identity cards. However, no casualty was reported.

An armed man who tried to force his way to the VIP lounge at the Islamabad airport died when a grenade he was carrying exploded during an exchange of fire with the security personnel. Some officials say that the hand grenade blast was actually a suicide bombing done by the attacker when he knew he was surrounded, but the DIG was reluctant to endorse this explanation, saying that it seemed more likely that the hand grenade he was carrying fell off his hand and exploded. The attack occured shortly after Prime Minister Shaukat Aziz returned from Gwadar on a special flight.  However, the police said that the real motives behind the attack could only be deciphered after a thorough investigation of the attack. Followup: Investigators discovered that the attack on the airport in Islamabad was directly linked to other attacks like the Marriot hotel attack, the muharram procession attack, etc. Religious militants, possibly linked to the local Taliban, were believed to be behind the attacks. Followup: The person who attacked the Islamabad airport was identified as Mohammad Younas who had links with the 'Amjad Farooqi group' of the banned sectarian outfit. It was discovered that the man was not on a suicide mission, but on a target killing mission, although his target did not seem to be a high profile personality'. It is still not clear who his target was and for what purpose.

Shahid Channa was shot dead by 4 people while he was sitting at a video store. The victim had been involved in the murder of Rahim Burfat about a year prior to this incident, and was out on bail. The victims brother nominated 3 tribesmen of the Burfut tribe in the FIR.
Tariq Mahmood was murdered and his body was in the fields at Chak No.185/P.
A man was killed and his friend was injured when their rivals opened fire on them in the crowded Bahrain Bazaar.
at least 7 rockets were fired at the FC ckeck post in Kahan area. However the rockets missed their targets resulting in no casualties.

One person was killed and three others were injured when an unidentified person opened fire on them outside the Haji Rehmat Ullah mosque in New Anarkali. Eyewitnesses said that a person with a AK-47 rifle approached the mosque and opened fire on a man outside and fled. He injured three others while fleeing towards circular road. The Imam of Haji rehmat ullah mosque stated that suspicious men had been caught wandering around the mosque in the past couple of days. The mosque was said to be a stronghold of Sipah-i-Sahaba Pakistan and they had been giving sermons and lectures there recently.

hundreds of workers staged a demonstration infront of the Small Industries Estate to protest ongoing gas and power loadshedding. They torched tyres, chanted slogans against the government, blocked roads and damaged some vehicles.
US drone attack in Asori village on a house of a cleric killed at least 9 persons including Al Qaeda financial affairs chief Abu Akash.
Three people were killed and another wounded in a land dispute between Bangash and Mengal tribes

A transporter, belonging to the Rehman Dacoit gang, was kidnapped and shot dead in Chakiwara as part of the continuing gang war between the gangs of Babu Dacoit and Rehman Dacoit. His bullet-ridden body was found in a gunny bag at Al Falah Chowk in Mohammedi Colony.

Muhammad Taj Abbasi, a candidate in the elections, lodged a case against some unidentified men who stormed in and damaged the chairs and tables. He also alleged that the attackers hurled threats of dire consequences to him and later escaped.
A rocket fired from an unknown location exploded near the private ward of the civil hospital, leaving one person injured.

A polling agent and brother of a Mohajir Qaumi Movement (MQM) candidate was beaten to death by the activists of the rival Haqiqi faction, while another was killed as a result of clashes between the two factions and several others were injured in different areas of Karachi.
a woman along with her alleged paramour was killed by her brother on suspicion of having illicit relations with Malook Mahar.

activists of Sunni Tehrik and Jamiat Ulema-i-Pakistan came out to voice their anguish at the death of Mufti Sarfaraz Naeemi in a suicide attack on Jamia Naeemia in Lahore. Unidentified men were seen firing in the air and forcing shopkeepers to pull down shutters. in Hyderabad, incidents of aerial firing were reported from a number of localities and Latifabad. unidentified men resorted to aerial firing in Hyder Chowk  area, UnitS 8, 9 and 11. they also burnt tyres on the road and roundabout.
Unidentified attackers opened fire on two young men in Dera Ismail Khan, injuring both in the attack.
A man was shot dead by unidentified gunmen.
Militants' headquarters at Savei in Mamond tehsil were heavily bombed by the military and 11 militants were killed in the operation.
An exchange of fire occurred between 2 groups, resulting in the death of Noor Siddiqui. Shan Mohammad was injured. This occurred during the by-elections for 3 NA seats and 1 PA seat.
Four gunmen shot dead the President of the Sindh Hari Committee and fled.

Some unknown persons had planted a bomb along the boundary wall of the Kohlu district jail which went off and caused a large explosion, which created panic in the area. However, no loss of life or damage to property was reported.
Militants fired rockets at oil tankers carrying fuel and supplies to NATO forces in Afghanistan. The rockets missed their targets and the vehicles remained unharmed.

Fifteen MMA workers reportedly suffered minor injuries during their clash with the police in sevral parts of the city. The allaince said that the police had arrested 200 of its workers from various parts of the city.
One Ghulam Hussain alias Guloo Khaskheli was stabbed to death by a dagger. The police arrested one Sanaullah Khaskheli.
Sihala police found the body of a man, Chaudhry Zahoor, who had been missing since 8th October.

An armed gang of land grabbers belonging to the Lund tribe tried to occupy a land of the Brohi clan. The villagers surrounded the invaders but a clash was averted when police came to the rescue. There was an exchange of fire between the police and the gang. Two armed men were arrested and the rest managed to escape. No casualties were reported.

A high-intensity bomb explosion on a public bus killed 6 passengers, including 3 children, and injured another 18. The bus was on route to Mangowal when the explosion took place. ; Follow-up: the death toll rose to 7 as one critically injured victims passed away.
A villager was shot dead while sleepimg inside his house by unidentified persons.
1 person was killed on the spot and 3 others injured when unknown armed men on motorbikes opened fire at them. Two of the injured succumbed to their injuries the next day.

A 46 year old truck driver was gunned down outside his home on Mahfooz Road in Malir when unidentified armed men opened fire on him, killing him on the spot. The motive behind the killing could not be ascertained.
A villager was seriously injured when the border village of Mollancy in Chaprar sector of Sialkot working boundary came under Indian fire by a machine-gun position.

As violence continued for the 4th day after the assassination of prominent MQM-H leader Mansoor alias Chacha, two people were critically injured when unknown people fired at them. They received bullet injuries to the head and one of them, identified as Saeed, succumbed to his injuries later in the night. The other victim, identified as Kamran, was stated to be in critical condition.
A merchant was shot dead over a property dispute by his neighbours. However, the police claimed both parties had a business dispute.

The Ajniawala police post which was set on fire by a mob on 27-jun-05 was razed by a mob after they blocked traffic on the two main roads. The protesters met with ASP city Ijaz Ahmad and DSP headquarters Zahid Husain and demanded the suspension of the entire police post staff and for the police post to be shifted outside the city. they ended their protest when their demands were met.

taxi-drivers blocked the road leading to Torkham at Sajamala Chowk to protest the removal of what the administration said were illegal taxi stands in the Landi Kotal bazaar. A Khasadar force headed by the Landi Kotal assistant political agent baton charged the protesters to clear the road.
Two sisters were killed by their borthers on suspicion of them having illicit relations.
A police constable was killed and another critically injured when armed men opened fire on a police van after the police tried to atop the said men from snatching another man's motorcycle.
Eight members of a family were killed while sleeping in their house.  It is suspected that the murders were based on a disputed piece of land.

Scattered incidents of violence took place in Hyderabad in reaction to the remarks given by Dr. Zulfikar Mirza against the MQM chief and his followers. A man was killed and fourteen others were injured when unidentified people resorted to aerial firing in the city. Right after Dr. Mirza's statements unidentified persons took to the streets, burnt tyres and chanted slogans against him.
Unidentified people hurled a hand grenade at policemen who were conducting a search operation. Several policemen sustained minor injuries.

A procession was taken out in Chilas to push for the acceptance of the local's demands before the construction of the Diamer-Bhasha Dam. The demands included payment of royalties, resolution of border dispute between Gilgit-Baltistan and KP, and increase in compensation for the land taken over by the government for the dam project. The procession pelted WAPDA offices with stones and the police fired teargas shells. Soon after, FC personnel opened fire at the protesters, killing Sabir Gul and Framulk. The firing triggered more protests in the Chilas where people took to the steets and burned down offices of police officials, two police checkposts and 2 government vehicles.
Muhammad Faraz Jafar and his accomplices attacked his opponents over a land dispute. One person of each party was killed.
A bullet riddled body of a young man was found behind a school wall.

The finance minister of Gilgit-Baltistan had a scuffle with CM Special Assistant Muhammad Musa after the latter interrupted him while he was requesting the Chief Minister to withdraw a posting order of an executive engineer. Following the scuffle, Mr Musa left the building but Mr Akhtar tried to jump from the first floor to get a hold of the CM Special Assistant. However, security guards saved him from falling. Later, supporters of the Finance Minister burnt tyres on Khazana Road to protest the incident.

A large number of ST activists and leaders protested against the posting of Taluka Municipal Officer Thull as District Monitoring Officer. The claimed that the TMO Thull, Abid Abro was guilty of misappropriating development funds and that no action had been taken against him. The protesters smashed the windows of the office and damaged furniture in addition to manhandling office staff.
A soldier was killed and another was hurt when a security check post in Kabal came under attack.
Abdul Fatah Agani allegedly killed his sister Bilqees for being an adulteress (Kari).

A police inspector was found lying in a pool of blood in the gallery of his flat in New Karachi Police Lines. A spent bullet was found from the scene, however, the weapon could not be recovered. The police ruled out the possibility of a suicide and suspected a silencer may have been used as no one at home heard the gunshot.
One person was gunned down by unidentified people  while he was sleeping at his house.
An unidentified body of a man with bullet wounds was found from Orangi extension.
Several TV artistes held a protest rally at the Governor House in order to demand a rise in their fees. The police manhandled the protesters and the protesters dispersed.

Students of Dawood College of Engineering and Technology staged a protest to demand accrediation of their university by Pakistan Engineering Council. They threw stones at moving vehicles and blocked traffic. Police were present to handle the situation.

Two militant groups Lashkar I Islam led by Mangal Bagh and Ansar ul Islam led by Ustaad Mehboob attacked each other using mortars and rocket propelled grenades in Tirah valley of Khyber Agency. Ansar ul Islam claimed over its FM radio station that it had killed 18 members of Lashkar i Islam and captured 10.
Youths belonging to MQM Haqiqi burnt tyres and vehicles to protest against the arrest of their leaders.

Ten militants were killed and Thirteen were injured when security forces raided militants' training camps in Dhol Ragha area of central Kurram. Seven of the injured were arrested and three hideouts were destroyed. Five vehicles laden with explosives were also destroyed.
An ANP activist Humayun Kohistani was killed and two others were injured by unidentified armed men in Gullistan-i-Jauhar on Monday.
a headless body was found in Mosa Neka Ziarat near Angoor Adda.
A senior lawyer and a security guard deployed for his security were shot dead by two unidentified men.
The body of an unidentified person was found in Raiwand City area on Sunday
US planes dropped bombs on a house in the Jabba area of the Ando Angor town on the Pakistan-Afghanistan border. No casualty was reported.

A man and his daughter were found slaughtered in a hotel room they had been living in. The hotel management said that a young man had visited the man in his hotel room, and the victim had told the hotel management that he was his son, and would be staying with them in the hotel room.  The bodies of the two deceased were found after the young man left the hotel room.
A man was wounded in a shooting incident Buffer Zone.
A railway track linking Pakistan and Iran was the target of a bomb blast, causing a cargo train to get derailed.
Six people were injured in a clash between two groups over a money dispute in Kashmir town on Wednesday night.
Reports from the area claim that a suspected US drone fired two missile on the house of on Gharib Nawaz, who had alleged links with foreign terrorists, injuring four people.
Two Afghan guards were found shot dead.The reason behind the killing could not be ascertained but police believe it was targetted.The two guards were affiliated with the Jamaat-i-Islami Afghanistan.

Students of Government Islamia High School staged a procession against the arrest of one of their teachers. They marched towards Danewal Police station and the police tried to stop them. The students pelted the police with stones. The resultant clash led to the injury of over 20 policemen and several students.
Following a fresh wave of violence, An MQM worker was shot dead and another was injured by unknown men in Nazimabad on Sunday.
Security forces and militants loyal to radical cleric Maulana Fazalullah clashed in Matta. 4 militants were killed and 2 were injured while 2 security personnel lost their lives.
A powerful explosion occurred near a cotton factory in the Rojhan Jamali tehsil. No loss of life was reported.
A girls' primary school was blown up.
Two tankers carrying supplies to Nato forces in Afghanistan were attacked by gunmen who went on to torch them. A driver was killed in the initial firing.
A constable was killed while two others were wounded when unidentified armed men opened fire on a patrolling party in Sector F-5 in New Karachi.
One of the bodyguards of local cheiftan, Sardar Abdul Rahman Khetran, was killed and another injured by unknown attackers  firing indiscriminately.

a mob of 3000 people set three churches on fire as well as the homes of 2 clergymen and destroyed a nursing hostel, nun's hostel, a convent school and 4 other houses in Sangla Hill area. The crowd was protesting against the alleged desecration of the Holy Quran. the police used teargas and baton-charged to disperse the crowd. the Church's own investigation suggested that the accusations were motivated by a dispute over money.
The incharge of Anti-Terrorist Squad-Ijaz Shafi Dogar was shot at and wounded by armed assailants in Wahdat Colony on Thursday.
The bullet-riddled body of Riaz Khan from Swabi was found in Shalobar area. No other detail was given.
Usman Abdul Hakim was killed when armed youths barged into his house while he was asleep and shot him. Police claim that he was was killed on suspicion of being a police informer

Following the assassination of senior MQM activist Shafiq Ahmed Ajmairi, Orangi town witnessed violence throughout the day. Akbar Sultan was gunned down in Aligarh. The MQM blamed the ANP for the killing of MQM workers and supporters while the ANP denied any involvement in the violence.

As part of the violence on the second day of a two-day strike called by the Mohajir Qaumi Movement (MQM), the KTC corporation claimed that some of their buses were damaged when miscreants pelted them with stones.
some unidentified persons shot dead the vice Chairman of Towns Committee Faqirwali and Ex-President of Pakistan Muslim League.

Residents of Sultanabad staged a protest over discontinuation of electricity in their locality. They pelted vehicles with stones and lit a bonfire on the main road causing a traffic jam for hours. Police arrived and assured them action would be taken. The crowd then dispersed peacefully.
A man was killed while his father and two brothers were seriously injured over a land dispute in Raiwind City.

Nine persons belonging to Jatoi tribe were killed in target shooting  near Kulab Jeal, district Khairpur. The victims were sitting in a hotel when members of the Ujjan tribe came on a wagon and opened fire on them.  The assailants, 20 in number, were led by a wanted criminal Buddho Ujjan.

a police constable was killed and 27 people including 18 police personnel were injured when an the Raisani Qaumi Ittihad blocked the National Highway in protest against the arrest of their party leader Wadood Raisani, and hurled a hand grenades and opened fire at an area on Sariab road. the police also returned fire. the armed people escaped and the highway was opened.

Angry protesters set on fire a shop that belonged to the sister of an MQM activist. In addition, incidents of firing and distruction of public and private property was reported as youths took to the streets to express their anger over the killing of 2 MQM-H activists.
a woman, Saeeda, was killed by her husband, Abdul Qadeer Shar, on the pre-text of karo-kari in Hayat Wah village situated in Dakhan area of Shikarpur district, after which he fled.
Scattered firing was reported in Kalosha area between the Uzbek militants and the local tribal Lashkars in an ongoing clash between foreign and local militants.
According to sources, militants fired rockets at the residence of a peace body member on Kohat Road, damaging the building.
Two unidentified motorcyclists shot and killed an owner of a showroom in Block 9, Gulshan-i-Iqbal. The motive of the murder could not be known.
All the residents of Chahi Dera Village were injured in Indian shelling along LoC in Samani Sector on Monday
A man was injured in 'sniper firing' in New Karachi.
Militants attacked security forces during a military search operation but the soldiers repulsed the attack, killing 4 militants and and injuring and capturing 8. 1 soldier was injured.
A 43 year old church was demolished in Garden town, Lahore by land mafia allegedly backed by the PML-Q. A demolition was held by the minorities over the demolition of the church.
A prominent tribal Malik, his wife and a minor were gunned down in Mandal village by unidentified assailants who entered their house while they were sleeping.
Rival groups of Abbas Kharal and Noor Kharal of the Hebokay Bara had a heated argument over a previous land dispute and exchanged fire, which resulted in the death of 2 persons.
a man was shot and another was injured in firing at Munda Bazaar when unidentified armed men entered a shop and opened fire.
The Jafir and Mari tribes clashed over a water dispute, injuring 2 people. Hatchets and clubs were used. The Karan police have registered a case.
A woman was killed and two others injured when they were fired upon by Indian forces with small arms from across the Line of Control in Neelum Valley.
The body of a young man was found from Gujjar Nullah in Karachi with his hands and feet tied with a rope.
Two Wapda revenue offices in Bakra Mandi Hyderabad and Unit No. 5, Latifabad were set ablaze by miscreants and were partially gutted.
A woman was injured in 'sniper firing' in Fedral B area.

Unidentified people fired missiles at the security checkpoint from a hilltop near the Gandao militia checkpoint. However, it caused no damage on life or property as one missile hit a tree while the timer of the other malfunctioned.

1 person was killed and 3 injured due to aerial firing in different parts of Lyari. The person killed was in Chakiwara. Background: Karachi has been gripped with fear after a week filled with incidents of targeted and indiscriminate killing which has strained the relationship between coalition parties MQM and PPP.
Adil Maqsood and Abid Ghulam Rasool were fired at indiscriminately by four motorcyclists who sped away after the shooting. Both the victims died while a passerby was wounded.

Six people were killed, four of them school children, and 12 others injured when Lashkar-i-Islam activists and security forces exchanged fire . The clash broke out when Lashkar-i-Islam activists and a group of school children marched towards the residence of their opponent Pir Saifur Rehman. Officials said that upon reaching the spot, some people in the crowd opened fire on the security forces, to whixh the security forces retaliated. The security forces claimed that activists of Lashkar-i-Islam were using the children as human shields. Lashkar-i-Islam, however, accused the security forces of of opening fire on a peaceful protest. Security secretary Arbab Mohammad Arif, however, claimed that 4 people were killed and 9 were injured as opposed to official reports of 6 killed and 12 injured.

Militants attacked the Adezai village with rockets, missiles and other heavy weapons killing one woman and two children and injuring two other people. The attack stopped when volunteers of the Adezai lashkar fired back. The Adezai village formed an anti-Taliban lashkar and Taliban have targeted such lashkars in the past.
Saeed Ahmed Rahoja was shot dead when some Katyar tribesmen opened fire at him in the Goth. No other detail was given.

Jaspal Singh and two other Sikhs were kidnapped and they family contacted for ransom. A local jirga and some relatives of the kidnapped people went to negotiate with the militants who handed them the beheaded body of Jaspal Singh. The other two Sikhs are still in captivity.
2 people were killed and 4 others were injured in Indian shelling along LoC in Neelum Valley on Thursday.
A powerful explosion was heard from Wadh. No other detail was given.
Memona Begum of Mohallah Noorpura, was allegedly murdered by her step-son Kashif. The murder was stated to be over a dispute over property.
Thirteen people were wounded when three rockets landed near a mosque in Bannu's Hussainabad area. Two of the rockets landed close to Imambargah Hussainia.

Nine people, including two security personnel, were injured when an FC vehicle was attacked with a grenade. The grenade missed the vehicle and exploded on the road. Mir Shahiq Baloch of the Balochistan Liberation United Front (BLUF) claimed responsibility for the attack.
Three policemen and seven others were injured in clashed between two rival political party workers.

A suicide bomber, trying to enter a bank, was intercepted by a security guard after which he detonated a bag full of explosives. The bomber was overpowered by the guard and fell to the floor after which the explosion took place. 2 people, including the security guard, were killed while 4 others were injured. The area, Sector I-8, is home to many senior intelligence agencies and army officers and also hosts some under-cover intelligence and law enforcement installations.
The Indian navy violated Pakistani territorial waters and captured 6 Pakistani fishermen along with their vessel and catch. The fishermen belonged to taluka Keti Bandar in Sindh.

Militants attacked  a security checkpost near the Pak-Afghan border. However, security forces had already been tipped-off about the planned attack and therefore managed to repulse it. 20 militants were killed and 25 were injured as they were forced to leave their weapons and retreat.
Argumand killed Hazrat Gul in Mamond area over a monetary dispute.

In the after math of Benazir Bhutto's assassination, PPP protesters gathered at Fowara Chowk, chanted slogans against the government and pelted buildings with stones. Later, they marched to PML-Q's office with iron rods and burnt furniture, banners and other property. Police had to resort to baton-charge and tear gas shelling to disperse the crowd. DPO sustained minor injuries.
Indian shelling across the LoC wounded twp people in Polas Kakuta village near Abbaspur sector

Residents of the Yousafabad area took to the streets in protest against a double murder in which two watchmen were killed. They blocked the road in protest and burnt tyres, demanding the arrest of the culprits immediately.
one man wass shot dead and wounded.
An armed clash between two tribes left 1 person dead and another injured. The gunbattle lasted for 3 hours.

A man was killed and another 4 were injured when two rival groups traded fire near the gate of the Civil Lines police station. Sakhi Sarwar Rana and Ali Khan had a previous quarrle. Police resorted to baton-charge when men of both the groups reached the hospital to kill their opponents.

A group of villagers exchanged fire with the Police who had raded a village in search of an absconder, Ahmed Loolo. The police opened fire on villagers who resisted the raid, killing Wali Mohammad on the spot and injuring two others. When the situation worsened, the Police fled the scene leaving behind their van. One of the wounded villagers, Saleem Solangi, died on his way to the hospital.
A constable was shot dead while standing at the bus stop by unknown attackers.
Militants planted explosives at the residence and hujra of Awami National Party's MNA Muzaffar ul Mulk Khan. No more details available.
violent demonstrators protesting against the frequent disruptions in power supply besieged the head office of the Karachi Electric Supply Company.
Following the rumor of an assassination attempt on the chief of the Sunni Tehrik in Pakpattan, two buses were torched in New Karachi. The rumor turned out to be false.
Angry tribesmen shot dead four militants belonging to the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan, when they violated the tribal code and continued performing stunts and creating disturbances in the area.
One Rasul Bux was shot dead by five persons over a land dispute.
A bullet riddled body of a former police offical was found. The body was stuffed in a gunny bag.

The PTI organized a rally against the possible release of Raymond Davis and the apathy of the rulers towards the issue. The protesters, who were not allowed to reach the US consulate, burnt a US flag and effigies of Senator John Kerry and Raymond Davis.
A man was hit by a stray bullet in Orangi Town.

After threatening, during a demonstration on 19-Jul-10, to set ablaze Mepco offices if loadshedding was not reduced, an angry mob attacked the local Mepco office and blocked 2 main roads for 3 hours. The police tried to disperse the mob but were pelted with stones.

Armed men attacked a coach, shot the driver and kidnapped several men and women of the Turi tribe. Following the incident rival factions blocked main roads and police was on high alert. Previous sectarian incidents had reportedly taken more than 100 lives in the area.

Students resisted a body search by Rangers on campus and a scuffle broke out. They pelted stones at vehicles and the police. They were dispersed by teargas. The Rangers also beat up some students and five were reportedly injured.
Manzar Imkani, 50, was gunned down and two others were injured in the area of North Nizamabad in Karachi.

Suspected militants detonated an explosive device when a van carrying policemen was passing by. However, even though the van was slightly damaged the primary victims were three women travelling in  car who received injuries.

Some parts of the city descended into violence once again after an activist of MQM was injured in a firing incident Orangi. In sector 1-D, armed persons intercepted a truck and set it on fire while another shop was also set ablaze.

Angry tribesmen blocked the Peshawer-Torkham highway, pelted vehicles with stones and clashed with the Khasadar force in protest against the killing of two persons by highwaymen in Gotki, Sindh. The relatives of the deceased dug out the mutilated bodies from the graves and brought them to protest. The relatives clashed with the Khasadar force by snatching their rifles when they resorted to aerial firing.  No injuries were reporte; Follow up: Protesting Tribesmen ended the two day blockade after the political administration promised monetary compensation for the families of the two men killed.
During a search operation, security forces arrested 32 suspected militants and seized a large number of arms and ammunition as well.

A quarrel, with sticks and chains, between two men of different sects took a communal turn  when the two gathered more people of their schools of thought for support, which then resulted in miscreants ransacking  three houses at Mohajir Chowk; setting furniture on fire. Later police had to resort to baton-charging to control the situation, however, the crowd pelted the police with stones before dispersing. The miscreants even attempted to set houses on fire but the police intervened. A meeting between two Ulemas of the sects was set up to ease the tension.
11 people were injured when a hand grenade exploded outside a building on Napier Road on Friday.

Former nazim of Keamari Town, Zulfiqar Younis, was beaten up by unidentified persons who barged into house early morning, warning him to withdraw the case that he had filed against the present town nazim. The present nazim was Humayun Khan, who had won by a small margin against Zulfiqar Younis in the Oct 6, 2005 election.
An activist of the Shahb-i-Milli, a youth wing of the Jamat-i-Islami, was gunned down in Surjani Town when two unidentified men on a motorbike opened fire on him and fled, killing him on the spot.

A beheaded body of a soldier was found near Darpakhel area with a chit with saying it was a gift for Afghan President Hamid Karzai. The chit also warned that spies and informers will meet the same fate in future. The body was identified as that of Haq Nawaz alias Dactar.

A vehicle carrying militants belonging to Hikmat Khan group was ambushed and fired on. The attack, in which 6 militants including Hikmat Khan were killed, was allegedly perpetrated by militants loyal to Mullah Toofan. The two groups had rivalries and had been involved in clashes in the past.
TJP Bhalwal President and Municipal Committee Councillor, Raja Nasrullah Khan, was killed in a grenade attack.
1 girl was killed and 15 others were injured when a bomb placed near a fruit pushcart went off at Ayub Chowk.
The police baton charged several jobseekers when they objected to the recruitment procedure adopted by the police during hiring recruiting new police officers. Several of them were injured.

Some 150 students, chanting anti-American slogans, pelted the US consulate with stones causing minor damage to the building. No one was killed or injured in the attack. The students were protesting the US missile attacks on Iraq.
Security forces shot dead a man in Bara bazaar for violating a curfew.

Arif and Ali Raza went to the house of Mukhtar Ahmad and forced him to sell his agricultural land to them. Arif and Ali Raza shot at and killed Mukhtar when he refused to accept their demand.The accused also shot dead Sharifan Bibi, a relative of Mukhtar, when she came out. Chunian police registered a case against the accused who were at large.
A former unit in charge of MQM was gunned down in Bihar Colony by unidentified men on a motorbike.
An unidentified man's body was found with his throat slit.
The blast in Kalat was a result of the bomb explosion near the slaughter house.
A clash between Marri and Burdi tribes left 10 villagers injured.
Two policemen were injured when a hand grenade was hurled into the Industrial Area Police Station. Part of the building was damaged.

After the incident where an SSP vice president, Sahiwal was attacked and injured, hundereds of students took to the streets to condemn the attack. They burnt tyres and chanted slogans against the SSP, Sahiwal.
a man and woman were shot dead by the 2 sons of his first emloyer who had been reprimanding him from meeting her.
Two young boys chopped off the head of their 16 year old cousin because she had stayed out of the house for two days.

two rockets were fired on the city by unknown people. One rocket landed on the Buledi House, damaging its roof and wall. A car was also damaged in the attack. The second rocket landed in godown in Killi Geshkori area, damaging a portion of the godown.
A man was hit and wounded by a stray bullet in Orangi.

Planes carried out strikes against militant positions in North Waziristan. there are reports that 12 militants were killed and 7 wouned in air strikes in Kotkai, Laddha and Sararogha. Six houses were also damaged in the bombings. A Mehsud stronghold and 2 militant compounds were destroyed.
Two home-made devices exploded near a military checkpost close to the Signal Training Centre’s ground in Kohat cantonment, killing several buffaloes in the nearby army dairy farm.
A man was knifed to death by the borther of his alleged paramour. The attacker managed to escape.
Two men on a motorbike shot and killed councillor Nadir Shah near his home. Mr. Shah was a close aide of the social activists, Nisar Baloch who was also assassinated in November 2009.
6 students were injured in a clash between two student groups-IJT and APMSO in Sindh Medical College on Thursday.
At least three houses were partially damaged when mortar shells fired by the security forces at hideouts of suspected militants hit houses in the Gandao area.

Baloch Students Organization-Azad (BSO-A) claimed that two of their members were recently targeted by security forces when they were sitting at a shop. However, the police deny the accusation and claim that unknown armed men opened fire at the shop which led to the killings.

An oil tanker carrying fuel for Nato forces in Afghanistan was set on fire in Ornach area. Some men first opened fire on the vehicle, prompting the driver and his helper to abandon the vehicle to save their lives. The men then set the vehicle on fire.

Three armed persons stormed the house of Malik Shafqat baloch and killed four persons who were accompanying a \zakir\" (a person who delivers religious sermons at Majlis) while they were asleep. Army was called upon to control the situation."

2 men suffered bullet injuries and six shops and 2 motorcycles were gutted when motorcyclists opened fire on people and hurled petrol bombs into the shops. The shops belonged to members of the Pakhtoon community and Pakhtoons were hit. Later angry people blocked the National Highway.
A bus of route 52-A was set ablaze in Ranchhor Lane.
2 missiles believed to be fired by a US drone aircraft struck a house killing 4 militants, including 2 Arabs.
One person was killed and six others were injured as the Indian forces stepped up shelling in Abiyaal Dogar village in Shakargarh-Narowal sectors.
Gas supply to some areas was suspended after a four-foot portion of a pipeline  was blown up near the eastern bypass.
A man was 'brought dead' from Baldia Town.

There was a fierce exchange of fire between two rival groups over a land dispute. Three people were killed and eight others injured. The elders of the tribe negotiated a ceasefire after hectic efforts.
A man allegedly shot dead his sister in their Amir Park residence on suspicion of loose morals, while she was sleeping in her bed.
Pirzada Intezar,a Shia scholar was shot dead by unidentified gunmen.He died on the spot.
a rocket was fired from the brewery area. It was not clear wether it exploded.
A person was shot dead by unknown men in Sukkur on Tuesday.
A person was killed by three masked men while he was sleeping under a tree in Shakargarh on Monday.
Police tortured and killed an elderly woman when she resisted the arrest of her grandson. Three policemen were arrested.
secuirty forces targeted militants hideouts. Locals said they destroyed a tanker and killed 2 people when a mortar shell hit the house of Rahmatullah. 3 local residents also received injuries.

10 people were killed and 18 others were injured in Dhari Village near Bhiria city, when more than a dozen armed people attacked the village and resorted to indiscriminate firing. Jumman Kalhoro was murdered a few days ago and Nihal Kalhoro and his accomplices were avenging his death.
Four Jatoi tribesmen were attacked and injured by Khaskheli tribesmen while they were working in the fields. They were attacked when they tried to divert the water to their land.

A student leader was beaten to death by activists of a rival student group. The Islami Jamiat-i-Talaba (IJT) said victim Hafiz Abdur Rehman was its nazim at the JPMC and was beaten to death by activists of the Punjabi Students’ Association. The IJT nazim alleged that criminal elements had occupied the hostels of the Sindh Medical College. He said no action was ever taken against those elements despite several complaints lodged with the college administration. (The exact reason behind the clash was not too clear from the report)
three soldiers were injured when militants fired rockets at a checkpost on Jandola Road.

A clash between security forces and militants at a checkpoint left one soldier and 3 militants dead. The clash occurred when militants opened fire on the security checkpost, which the security personnel responded to, killing 3 militants.
Violence broke out in Islampura when protesters took to the streets against the power outages. They torched a lesco office in Islampura.
Two people were killed when they were shot at by unidentified assailants in a passing car. The reason behind the attack is not known.

Dr. Junaid Shakir was intercepted by two men on a motorbike and shot dead. The police, based on some eyewitness acounts, claimed that the victim died while resisting a robbery. However, the family of the victim, based on other contradictory accounts, denied that it was a robbery attempt.
Security forces blew up a centre of a religious outift near Ayoub Pull Kanjo with explosives and arrested 15 militants during a search operation in Kabal.
A man killed his wife on the pretext of karo-kari in Saleh Pat on Thursday
Shelling by security forces on militant hideouts left 3 civilians injured.
There were several incidents of violence on the eve of the union council polls. In a shooting incident, Iqbal and Siraj died and their two companions were seriously injured.
Three soldiers were killed when militants fired a number of rockets on the Landi Noor camp in South Wazireistan from the Taliban controlled Mehsud area.
The bodies of two unidentified young men were found with multiple bullet wounds. Both victims had blindfolds and their hands were tied with rope.
Yaqoob, a guard at the WAPDA hospital was shot dead by unidentified assailants who barged into the hospital.
1 person was killed and 2 were injured in Indian shelling along LoC on a passanger bus in Neelum Valley on Friday.

Volunteers of the peace committee exchanged heavy fire with militants in the Khwaizai Baizai tehsil of Mohmand and arrested six militants.  The volunteers were helping the security forces flush out militants from the area.
Advocate Pir Tariq, a leader of MQM was shot at and injured by unidentified gunmen.
The bullet riddled bodies of two Muttahida Qaumi Movement workers were found. Both of them had been kidnapped in the morning.
A young man was shot dead by armed men while he was sitting In his guest house in Khairpur. The deceased was brother of General Secretary of PML-N Khairpur, Ghulam Hyder Phulpoto.
Workers of the MQM demolished a police kiosl and burnt tyres on the road to protest against the killing of an MQM activist earlier that day.
The bodies of two young men, wards of Karachi University were found. They had been kidnapped a day earlier from Time Square. The motive behind the act is not known.

Protesting students of MAO College attacked a United Muslim Hospital and damaged its neon signs and window panes in protest against the arrest of a collegue Abid Chaudhry, the Vice President Elect of the Student Union of MAO College.

Clashes between Mangal and Bangash tribes continued and intensified on the 14h consecutive day of fighting as 34 people lost their lives and 5 small villages were set ablaze. Militants attacked each other with rockets and heavy weapons. In a bid by the authorities to intervene, helicopter gunships shelled the area, killing 2 children and still not being able to stop the fighting. Fighting continued till the filing of this report and it was reported that armed tribesman had taken positions on top of hills in the adjacent Piwar area.
A bomb strapped to a parked bicycle was detonated by remote control when a police vehicle was passing by. The explosion killed 2 policemen and a shopkeeper and injured another 19.

two bombs were hurled at the house of Khursheed Ahmed, the president of thE Gilgit Press Club near the city police station. However no damage was caused to the 7 inmates. This was the second attack on his house.
a man was shot dead, Inayat, while another was injured, Younas, by their rivals over a land dispute.
Malikdinkhel and Qambarkhel sub clans clashed over the ownership of Surghar top hills. They exchanged fire using heavy weapons, resulting in the death of 3 and injury of 2.
In retailation for a daytime robbery in the home of a local goldsmith, a group of people staged a sit-in in Dadu.  The police resorted to baton-charging to disperse the crowd.
Arsonists set ablaze a store of Pakistan Telecommunication and a jeep in Malir.

The beheaded bodies of 3 truckers, who had been kidnapped while they were travelling between Parachinar and Peshawar a few days earlier, were found. A note accompanying the bodies said that if anyone else supplied goods to the Parachinar community he would meet the same fate.
2 FC men were killed and 7 others were injured when an FC vehicle was petrolling an area along Rabi Canal on Thursday and a bomb exploded near it.

Deputy Nazim of Charsadda, Alamzeb Omerzai, was shot and wounded when 6 unidentified gunmen shot at his vehicle. His bodyguards retaliated by firing back. According to his brother, the people who Omerzai defeated in the local body election were the ones behind the attack.
a minor girl, Maruim was injured after tribesmen opened fire on a passenger van in the Pesh Bogi area when the vehicle was on its way to Dear Bugti from Sui.
Police used tear gas and baton charge to disperse an angry mob. The mob was protesting against the beating of a driver by the police. Over a dozen people including two policemen were hurt.

Five people clubbed to death a man and seriously injured his wife over a matrimonial issue. Sources said that the married Ameena of Pakpattan had eloped with Saeed of Sahiwal and started living in Lahore. Her family finally traced her down and attacked her and her husband, injuring her and killing the husband.
Continued Unprovoked firing at the LoC by the Indian forces claims civilian lives.
Five people were injured in incidents of firing.

As a result of the verdict of supreme court annulling the appointment of Justice (Retd) Deedar Shah as NAB chairman, reports of gunfire were received from old city areas including Lyari, Kharadar and Ranchore Line.

Businesses were closed and traffic remained off-road in most cities and towns of the country on a strike call given by religious parties in protest against what they believed the government plans to change the Blasphemy Law. Police claimed that protesters near the residence of President Asif Ali Zardari shouted slogans and pelted stones. However, no one was reported hurt. POlice had to relatiate by using tear gas shells to disperse the crowd.

An explosive device went off in the parking area in a parking area adjacent to the West Cantonment police station. The device planted under a parked car went off damaging 25 vehicles and windowpanes of the buildings nearby.

A rally arranged by the SSP to criticize the government and to appeal to the people to join the strike planned for 30-Dec-95, was baton-charged by the police. The police also resorted to aerial firing to disperse the processionists and arrested all the district leaders of the SSP.
At least 15 students were injured in a clash between two student groups-MSF and IJT at Government Faridia College, Pakpattan over wall chalking on Monday.
a militant was killed in Peochar. 5 other suspected militants had been killed in other clashes.

Groups of flour-starved people brought the provincial capital of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa to a standstill, looted several general stores, a utility store and blocked many roads. Mobs attacked shops and business areas at several places by pelting them with stones, breaking their windowpanes. They also looted stores in the Qissakhawani area. Angry protesters then looted a utility store in the Tehkal area and according to officials the Jamrud and Abdara road were the worst hit. Police deployed to control the situation was reluctant to stop the protesters from damaging public property in the Tehkal, Cantonment and Jamrud road areas.
